raw.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Director of GTM Strategy and Operations to be the operational engine behind our go-to-market team. We know our market — now we need to win it faster. This role is about building the infrastructure, automation, and analytics that compress our sales cycle, increase pipeline velocity, and give leadership the visibility to forecast with confidence.

You'll sit at the intersection of sales operations, marketing operations, and revenue intelligence — owning the systems, data, and workflows that turn our GTM strategy into repeatable, measurable execution. This is not a "keep the lights on" role. You'll identify gaps, design solutions, and drive adoption across the team.

What You'll Do

Revenue Operations & Automation

  • Own and evolve the GTM tech stack — Salesforce, HubSpot, and the surrounding ecosystem — ensuring clean data flow, tight integrations, and minimal manual work
  • Design and implement automation across the funnel: lead routing, handoff workflows, enrichment pipelines, follow-up sequences, and deal stage triggers
  • Build and maintain integrations between revenue tools (CRM, MAP, sequencing platforms, data enrichment, BI) so teams operate from a single source of truth
  • Identify and eliminate process friction that slows deals down — from first touch through closed-won
  • Partner with technical resources to architect scalable RevOps infrastructure; you set the strategy and requirements, others execute the builds

Sales Operations & Cycle Optimization

  • Operationalize the sales process — MEDDPICC adoption, stage exit criteria, deal inspection frameworks — so reps are consistent and managers have real visibility
  • Build and maintain pipeline management cadences: weekly reviews, deal health scoring, and escalation triggers that surface risk early
  • Analyze sales cycle data to identify where deals stall, drop, or slow — then build fixes into the process and tooling
  • Partner with Sales leadership on territory management, quota modeling, and capacity planning
  • Support call review and coaching workflows to surface winning patterns and replicate them across the team

Data, Tracking & Analytics

  • Define and own the GTM data model: what we track, how we track it, and how it flows between systems
  • Build dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, velocity, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy
  • Create predictive models and lead/deal scoring frameworks that help reps and managers prioritize where to spend their time
  • Establish win/loss tracking and analysis to feed continuous learning back into sales and marketing strategy
  • Ensure data hygiene across CRM and marketing platforms — standardized fields, enforced inputs, reliable reporting

Marketing Operations

  • Partner with Marketing on campaign attribution, lead lifecycle tracking, and MQL-to-SQL conversion optimization
  • Own the lead routing and handoff process between marketing and sales — clean, fast, and accountable
  • Build closed-loop reporting between marketing activity and revenue outcomes
  • Support segmentation models that power targeted campaigns, personalized outreach, and account prioritization

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot — you know how to configure, integrate, and get the most out of both
  • Proven track record building automation and workflow systems that measurably improved sales team efficiency or cycle time
  • Strong analytical skills — you can build a model, interpret pipeline data, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leadership
  • Experience building or owning forecasting and pipeline visibility frameworks
  • Excellent communicator who can work across Sales, Marketing, and the C-suite without losing clarity or speed
  • A bias toward automation: if you do something twice, you build a system for it
  • Comfort with AI/LLM tooling for GTM use cases — you've used it to save time and you'll bring that mindset to the team

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with enrichment and data tools: Clay, Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, or similar
  • Familiarity with workflow automation platforms like Zapier, n8n, or Make
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
  • Background in or exposure to the insurance or insurtech space

Why This Role

You'll have direct access to C-level leadership and real ownership over the systems and strategy that drive revenue. This is a build role — we have the foundation, the market, and the product. We need someone who can operationalize it all and make our GTM team run faster and smarter. If you want the seat where those decisions get made, this is it.

90-Day Success Milestones

  1. Systems audit and roadmap — document current state of the GTM stack, identify integration gaps, data quality issues, and automation opportunities; deliver a prioritized roadmap
  2. Pipeline visibility and forecasting — build or rebuild the dashboards and cadences leadership uses to inspect pipeline health and call the number
  3. Quick wins on automation — identify and ship 2–3 high-impact automation improvements (lead routing, handoff workflows, follow-up sequences, or similar)
  4. Win/loss framework — design and stand up a structured win/loss program that feeds insights back to sales and marketing on a recurring basis
Base annual salary
$180,000—$215,000 USD

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles, instead, we honor effort and intelligence. The best idea wins no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

If you are a California resident, please be aware Sureify collects personal information from you during the application process, which may include your name, contact details, employment history, and educational background, in accordance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). We use this information solely to evaluate your candidacy for employment and may share it with internal hiring personnel as needed.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Northwest, AR

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

Zencore is a fast-growing company founded by former Google Cloud leaders, architects, and engineers. We are seeking candidates with significant experience in Google Cloud to join our team. Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. We embed within customer teams to provide strategic guidance, facilitate technology decisions, and execute projects in a collaborative, co-development style.
As a member of our Cloud Engineering team, you will be working with fast-paced innovative companies, leveraging Cloud as the key driver of their transformation. Our clients will look to you as their trusted advisor, someone they can rely on and who will be there to help them along their Google Cloud journey. You will be expected to work a large spectrum of technology and tools, including public cloud platforms, AI and LLMs, Kubernetes, data processing systems, databases, and more.
Note: This will be a short-term contract. No expectation set that this will transition into a full time role

What you will do...

  • Working with our clients to understand their requirements and technical challenges. Using this input you will develop a technical design for a solution and communicate the value of your solution to the client team.
  • You will work to develop delivery estimates and an estimated project plan.
  • You will act as the lead technical member of the implementation project team. You are responsible for making the key technical and keeping delivery on track. You should be able to unblock when things are stuck.
  • Utilize a broad range of technologies such as Kubernetes, AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), to develop scalable and efficient cloud applications.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and new technologies to drive continuous improvement in cloud solutions and practices.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end cloud solutions, from conceptualization to deployment and maintenance.
  • Engage in problem-solving and troubleshooting to address complex technical challenges in a cloud environment.

What we need...

  • 5+ years of experience working in a Software Engineering capacity
  • Excellent knowledge and experience with Python, and preferably additional languages such as Go
  • Strong critical thinking skills, and a bias towards problem solving
  • Familiarity with implementing microservice architectures
  • Fundamental skills with Kubernetes. You should be familiar with packaging and deploying your applications to k8s
  • Experience building applications that work with data, databases, and other parts of the data ecosystem is preferred
  • Familiarity with Generative AI workflows, frameworks like Langchain, and experience with Streamlit are all highly desirable, but at a minimum you should have a willingness to learn
  • Experience deploying production workloads on the public cloud - either GCP or AWS
  • Experience using CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc
  • Able to work with new tools and technologies where you may not have prior experience
  • Comfortable with being on video in meetings internally and with clients
  • Strong English communications skills

Why work here...

  • We are professionals you can Trust. Our people have extensive experience to get the job done
  • We share unbiased opinions and are comfortable with the hard truths. You are the subject matter experts for our customers.
  • We are the Missing Link. You will connect our customers to Google and move quickly when others can’t
  • We remove uncertainty and risk by clearly outlining the process of cloud migration for our customers
  • We accelerate timelines and do not dwell on a challenge. You’ll move faster and expose “unknown unknowns” for our customers
  • We show empathy. Our customers believe in us because we can relate to their complexities.

How to succeed...

  • First rule at Zencore - Be Kind
  • Own the process - own your customer’s success by proactive practices
  • Work hard to reach the destination, but make sure to enjoy the journey
  • Champion a consistent collaborative culture
  • Be receptive to all types of Feedback
  • Challenge the Status Quo

raw.description:
Company Overview

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE CANADA WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.

We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a UX/UI Designer to design thoughtful, high-quality digital experiences across a range of client engagements. This role is ideal for a curious, collaborative designer who enjoys solving real problems and bringing ideas to life — from early concepts through polished delivery.

In this role, you will partner closely with client product teams and our internal team to turn complex ideas into clear, intuitive, and engaging experiences. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where quality and delivery speed matter, collaborating with experienced designers and growing the instincts that come from shipping things that matter.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Design end-to-end UX/UI deliverables from early exploration and concepting through high-fidelity execution
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs that balance usability, business goals, and technical constraints
  • Build, evolve, and maintain design systems that support consistency, scalability, and flexibility across products
  • Conduct UX research activities including usability testing and user interviews to inform design decisions
  • Use Figma confidently for design, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your design work, using tools like Figma AI and Claude to improve efficiency, creativity, and design quality

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner closely with client product teams to understand problems, shape solutions, and deliver meaningful outcomes
  • Collaborate with engineers, strategists, and delivery leads to bring designs to life effectively and efficiently
  • Participate in agile workflows and balance multiple projects, clients, and industries while maintaining a high bar for craft

Leadership & Influence

  • Take ownership of design work end-to-end and follow through with craft and consistency
  • Contribute to internal initiatives such as marketing, pitches, and the evolution of the design practice
  • Stay curious and keep growing — bring new ideas, experiment often, and embrace continuous improvement

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of professional experience as a UX/UI Designer working on digital products or platforms
  • Strong hands-on design skills with deep proficiency in Figma
  • Experience building and maintaining design systems in real-world product environments
  • Working knowledge of UX research methods including usability testing and user interviews
  • Experience working directly with clients or cross-functional product teams
  • A collaborative mindset with comfort giving and receiving design feedback
  • Ability to adapt to design approaches across different industries, users, and problem spaces
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI-assisted design tools and workflows (e.g., Figma AI, Claude)
  • Experience with motion design, advanced prototyping tools, front-end concepts, or workshop facilitation is a plus

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Thriveworks is currently seeking Part-Time Independently Licensed LCSW to provide telehealth sessions in California*.

*Candidate can live in any state in the USA but MUST be licensed in the state of California

About the Job

The Clinical Talk Therapist is an active member of the Corporation’s clinical team and is responsible for moving us toward a world-class clinical experience. This role impacts multiple stakeholders, including Participants, Clinical Specialists, and the Health Care Industry at large. The Specialist delivers the best quality of care to the Participant to help them reach the agreed-upon goals for an improved quality of life and well-being. The Specialist partners closely with the Operations team to improve experiences of processes of efficiency and ease of access, as well as with the Clinical team to improve the delivery of clinical care and support.

Thriveworks is a trusted mental health provider with 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model. We serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and those numbers are growing. As a clinician-founded and clinician-led organization, we offer the tools, support, and community you need to build a fulfilling, long-term career.

    • 15+ hours of direct counseling care per week

  • Treatment team meetings with the customer, as applicable

  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Experience working with children is preferred

  • Informed on state telehealth policies

  • Comfortable with technology and conducting sessions via telehealth

  • Capability to build a therapeutic relationship in a virtual platform

  • Polished, professional virtual presence

  • Strong ability to identify markers for the appropriate level of care to meet patient needs

  • Experience with treating a variety of conditions and disorders as part of a comprehensive treatment plan with an interdisciplinary team

  • No-show protection and caseload build within 90 days of credentialing

  • Credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Opportunities for paid resident supervisory roles

  • A vibrant clinical community—online and in person

  • Monthly peer consultations and professional development

  • A clear path for career growth and internal promotion

A Place to Belong and Thrive
Thriveworks is a certified Great Place to Work and a community built on inclusion, growth, and support. Whether you’re seeking mentorship, advancement, or a place where your impact matters, you’ll find it here. 93% of our team reports feeling included, and 87% say their work has purpose—and we think that says a lot.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.

At AbsenceSoft, we’re transforming the employee experience. Our secure, intuitive technology helps employers bring humanity, certainty, and efficiency to some of the most complex moments in the workplace. Built by HR professionals for HR professionals, we’re proud of where we’ve been and even more excited about where we’re going.

As our Instructional Designer, you'll build the training content that powers AbsenceSoft University — the courses, learning paths, and assessments customers and partners rely on to master our platform. You'll develop deep product expertise and partner closely with our compliance team to keep content accurate as leave and accommodations laws evolve. Working independently within established instructional design practices, you'll translate complex product changes and regulatory updates into clear, engaging content customers can actually use. As a trusted partner to Product, Compliance, and Customer Success, you'll directly support faster customer onboarding, stronger product adoption, and fewer support escalations. This role reports to the Director, Customer Education.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and build courses, learning paths, and assessments — including quizzes and certification exam content — that reflect our product and how customers actually use it, applying sound instructional design practices and SCORM/xAPI standards.
  • Build deep expertise in the AbsenceSoft platform, serving as the team's go-to resource on what's changing and why it matters for training.
  • Partner with the product team to gain early visibility into upcoming releases, updating training content before or as those releases launch.
  • Collaborate with the compliance team to translate regulatory updates into accurate content, with final review from the Director, and maintain clear records of what's changed and why.
  • Use course data to identify what's working and where content needs a refresh.
  • Uphold organizational security and compliance controls within the scope of this role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 3+ years of experience in instructional design or curriculum development, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • A self-directed, naturally curious learner who builds deep product expertise independently and knows when to move forward solo versus loop in a manager.
  • Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, or state leave laws, with the ability to collaborate with a compliance team and synthesize regulatory updates into clear, usable content.
  • Strong writing skills, translating technical or dense material into clear, accessible content.

raw.title: Head of Partner Programs, Strategy and Operations
raw.excerpt: Apollo. io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises.
raw.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As the Head of Partner Operations, you will build and own the operating system that allows Apollo's Partnerships business to scale. Sitting within Revenue Operations, you will be the connective tissue between partner strategy and the company-wide systems, data, processes, and commercial infrastructure that make partner motions work.

This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal. Partner Managers own relationships and execution; you own the operational infrastructure underneath them and you’ll help co-author our partner strategy. You'll establish the metrics and reporting that leadership uses to understand partner performance, architect the processes and systems that support different partner motions, and ensure the commercial mechanics behind those motions work reliably.

You'll operate across Apollo's technology, agency, integration, and strategic partner ecosystem. The goal isn't simply to make today's processes run better. It's to build a scalable Partner Operations function that can absorb new partner motions, eliminate operational friction, and give the business a clear understanding of where partnerships are creating revenue and where the model needs to evolve.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to build a function, not inherit a playbook.

Partnerships is becoming an increasingly important part of Apollo's revenue ecosystem, but partner motions create a unique operational challenge: the work crosses organizational boundaries, the data often lives across multiple systems, and the right operating model changes as the business learns.

The Head of Partner Operations will be responsible for turning that complexity into leverage. You'll help define how Apollo measures partner impact, how partner motions are structured, how systems support them, and how the company can scale partner revenue without scaling operational overhead at the same rate.

The strongest person in this role will leave the Partnerships organization with something substantially better than they found it: a clear operating model, trusted data, scalable systems, reliable commercial mechanics, and a set of partner motions that can evolve without rebuilding the infrastructure from scratch.

What You'll Do

Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Build the operating system for Partnerships. Establish the processes, systems, data model, and governance that allow Partnerships to operate as a measurable, scalable revenue channel. Define clear ownership across Partner Managers, RevOps, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders, and create the operating cadence that keeps the machine running.
  • Architect partner motions and commercial models. Partner with the VP of Partnerships and RevOps to design how different partner motions should work end-to-end, from acquisition and qualification through onboarding, activation, revenue generation, expansion, and renewal. Translate strategy into concrete operating models, including workflows, incentives, tiering, deal mechanics, attribution, systems requirements, and measurement.
  • Create a trusted measurement layer for the partner business. Own the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership visibility into partner-driven performance. Establish the operating definitions, instrumentation, dashboards, and recurring reporting for metrics such as the agency funnel, integration adoption, Partner-Involved ARR, sourced/influenced/managed attribution, and partner cohort NRR. Partner with RevOps, Finance and Analytics, while owning the operationalization and ongoing reliability of the resulting metrics.
  • Turn partner data into a decision-making system. Build the mechanisms that allow Partnerships and company leadership to understand which partners, motions, and investments are driving outcomes. Identify gaps in data quality and attribution, establish clear data ownership, and drive remediation upstream. Help drive decisions about where to invest, what to scale, and what to change.
  • Own the partner systems architecture in partnership with Systems. Translate partnership requirements into a coherent systems roadmap spanning Salesforce, PartnerStack, Crossbeam, Apollo, and other connected tooling. Work with Systems and Data Engineering to ensure partner data is captured correctly, flows between systems, and remains usable for reporting and automation. You won't be the administrator for every system; you'll own the requirements, architecture, prioritization, and operating model that make those systems work together.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity to execution. Partnerships will generate problems that don't fit neatly inside one team's ownership. You'll take ambiguous business needs, turn them into structured requirements, identify the right owners, and drive execution. You are accountable for getting the operating model to a working state even when you don't directly own every component.
  • Continuously improve the economics and efficiency of the partner motion, but not at the expense of growth. Use operational data to identify friction, leakage, and unnecessary manual work across the partner lifecycle. Develop the business case for process changes, automation, or new tooling, and measure whether those investments actually improve partner productivity, revenue contribution, data quality, or operating leverage.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Partner Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related function, with experience operating in a B2B SaaS environment and working across multiple GTM functions. Must have direct experience in Partnerships within this.
  • Experience building an operating function from the ground up. You've created processes, systems, reporting, and governance where there wasn't previously a mature operating model, and you know how to balance getting today's work done with building what will replace it.
  • Strong understanding of partnerships and partner-led motions. You understand the operational mechanics behind agencies, technology/integration partners, channel programs, strategic partnerships, or similar ecosystems. You understand how partner economics, attribution, incentives, deal registration, and partner lifecycle management work.
  • A systems thinker with a builder's bias. You naturally look for the underlying system behind a recurring problem. Rather than building another workaround, you ask what process, data model, workflow, or automation would prevent the problem from happening again.
  • Strong analytical instincts. You're comfortable working with funnel, pipeline, revenue, cohort, and attribution data and can move between executive-level business questions and the underlying data required to answer them. You know how to distinguish a measurement problem from a business problem.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership without relying on formal authority. You can align multiple XFN Stakeholders around a shared operating model, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive work to completion even when the underlying components are owned by different teams.
  • Strategic and operational range. You can participate in a conversation about the future of Apollo's partner strategy in the morning and then get into the details of an attribution definition, Salesforce workflow, or revenue-share process in the afternoon.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Partner motions are still being built. You should be comfortable creating structure where there isn't much, making decisions with incomplete information, and iterating quickly as the business learns.
  • Strong written and verbal communicator. You can write a crisp operating proposal, explain a complex systems dependency to an executive, turn an ambiguous request into requirements for Engineering, and create documentation that a broader team can actually use.
  • High ownership and strong judgment. You know which problems require a durable solution, which can be handled pragmatically, and when to pull in the right functional owner. You optimize for the health of the overall revenue system rather than protecting functional boundaries.

AI Fluency & Tooling

Apollo operates at the intersection of AI and go-to-market, and our Revenue Operations organization is expected to lead from the front. This role requires genuine fluency in leveraging AI as part of how you operate and build.

That means:

Using LLMs as an active operating partner. Whether you're analyzing partner performance, developing SQL, drafting requirements, documenting processes, investigating data quality issues, or preparing an executive recommendation, you should be reaching for AI tools wherever they can materially accelerate your work.

Designing partner operations for an AI-native environment. Think beyond dashboards and workflows toward how structured partner data, documentation, and operating context can be made accessible to AI agents and internal tools. You should understand the importance of clean schemas, canonical definitions, semantic documentation, and reliable system interfaces.

Using AI to increase operating leverage. The expectation is that a single operator can accomplish substantially more by combining strong judgment with AI-assisted analysis, development, automation, and documentation.

Staying ahead of the tooling curve. The AI tooling landscape is moving quickly. We're looking for someone who experiments, learns independently, shares what works, and continuously looks for ways to replace manual operational work with better systems.

Knowing where AI should and shouldn't be trusted. AI can accelerate analysis and execution, but it can also introduce hallucinations, incorrect assumptions, and false confidence. You should have strong enough operational and analytical judgment to validate AI-generated outputs and know when first-principles analysis is required.

Scope & Ownership

Partner Operations sits within Revenue Operations and owns the infrastructure that makes the Partnerships business measurable and scalable.

Partner Operations owns:

  • Partner-business reporting, measurement, and recurring instrumentation
  • Partner data quality and attribution
  • Partner systems requirements, architecture, and operating processes
  • Partner lifecycle and funnel instrumentation
  • Deal-registration and commercial operations
  • Partner agreement and amendment administration in partnership with Legal
  • Revenue-share operational tracking and payout process coordination with Finance
  • Partner-related data requests and cross-functional operational workflows
  • Design and documentation of partner operating models and processes
  • Requirements and coordination for systems and data builds
  • Continuous improvement and automation of partner operations

Partner Operations partners with, but does not replace:

  • Partner Managers, who own partner relationships, partner strategy, and commercial relationships
  • Systems, who own company-wide systems administration and technical implementation
  • Data Engineering / RevOps Analytics, who own underlying data infrastructure and statistical methodology where applicable
  • Finance, who owns financial controls and payout execution
  • Legal, who owns legal review and contractual risk
  • BizOps, who provides strategic guidance and project support on broader cross-functional initiatives
  • Partner Marketing / Academy, who own co-marketing strategy and certification/badge program design
  • Partnerships technical resources, who may build lightweight agents, automations, or prototypes outside the core company-wide systems infrastructure

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)
$250,000—$315,000 USD
Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)
$220,000—$275,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

raw.description:
Project Manager (Technical)

Location: Remote US

Who We Are:

Enterra Solutions is introducing the world’s top brands and market leaders to true enterprise intelligence. Powered by our groundbreaking Enterra Autonomous Decision Science™ Platform, we’re delivering enterprise-wide optimization and decision-making to help businesses best achieve their most complex goals. We’re providing real human insights to facilitate smarter, faster market moves. And we’re turning unknowns into opportunities for unprecedented growth and agility. All with next-level speed, accuracy, autonomy, and continuous learning. We’re shaping the future - join a dynamic, collaborative team where your contributions drive real impact.

Overview

The Project Manager (PM) oversees the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, client expectations, and quality standards. The PM serves as a central point of communication between stakeholders and project teams, manages resources effectively, mitigates risks, and drives continuous process improvement to maximize the success and profitability of projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Define project scope, deliverables, tasks, timelines, and charters; develop comprehensive project plans in MS Project and Excel aligned with client and organizational requirements.

raw.description:
Looking to build your career and design your future? You have come to the right place.

We are seeking a skilled SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Integration Specialist with strong BI development expertise to design, build, and maintain data integration solutions across our SAP and Azure landscape. In the near term, this role will focus on connecting SAP BDC with Azure Data Factory (ADF) to ensure reliable, high-quality data flow into our Azure Data Lake (ADLS), supporting downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML workloads. Over time, the role will lead the migration away from ADF — replacing it with native SAP Datasphere pipelines that feed directly into Power BI — consolidating our analytics stack within the SAP BDC ecosystem. This role is critical to enabling data-driven decision-making by bridging SAP source systems with modern cloud analytics and reporting platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Configure SAP BDC and Datasphere as the primary data source — set up connections, data flows, and outbound endpoints consumed by existing ADF pipelines
  • Design and implement data integration solutions within SAP Business Data Cloud, including data ingestion, transformation, replication, and orchestration
  • Expose SAP data via OData services, REST APIs, or Open Connectors from within SAP BDC/Datasphere for ADF and downstream consumption
  • Define and publish SAP CDS Views from S/4HANA into Datasphere as the primary extraction layer feeding downstream pipelines
  • Set up remote tables, replication flows, and data persistence layers within Datasphere to reliably stage data
  • Ensure delta and CDC enablement on the SAP side so incremental pipelines receive correct, complete data
  • Manage authentication and secure connectivity between SAP BDC and Azure — OAuth, service principals, and SAP Integration Suite where applicable
  • Maintain existing ADF pipelines — monitor performance, troubleshoot failures, and ensure SLA adherence during the transition period
  • Plan and execute the migration of ADF pipelines into native SAP Datasphere data flows and transformation layers
  • Build and optimize Datasphere analytical datasets and semantic models to serve as the direct source for Power BI
  • Configure and maintain SAP Datasphere to Power BI connectivity — live connection, DirectQuery, or dataset publish patterns
  • Develop and maintain BI reports, dashboards, and analytical models using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and/or Power BI
  • Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Monitor data pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data quality and integrity
  • Document integration architecture, data flows, migration progress, and BI solutions; support end-user training and adoption

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with SAP BW/4HANA Open Hub as an alternative or legacy extraction mechanism
  • Familiarity with SAP HANA Cloud and CDS-based analytical data modeling
  • Knowledge of Python or SQL scripting for transformation automation within SAP BDC
  • Experience with Power BI dataflows, semantic models, and enterprise-scale report governance
  • SAP certification in Datasphere, Analytics Cloud, or BW/4HANA

SAP Business Data Cloud Integration Specialist

Summary

The SAP Business Data Cloud Integration Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data integration, business intelligence, analytics, and reporting solutions across the SAP and Azure ecosystem. This role serves as a technical subject matter expert for SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) and Datasphere, enabling the organization to leverage data as a strategic asset by connecting SAP source systems with modern cloud analytics and reporting platforms — including Power BI and SAP Analytics Cloud. In addition to building and managing data integration frameworks, the role leads the near-term ADF integration and drives the longer-term migration of ADF pipelines into native Datasphere data flows.

The position partners with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technology teams to deliver scalable data integration solutions, analytical models, dashboards, and reporting capabilities that support operational, financial, and strategic decision-making.

Data Integration & Architecture

  • Configure SAP BDC and Datasphere as the primary data source — set up connections, data flows, and outbound endpoints consumed by existing ADF pipelines

Additional Responsibilities

Education & Experience

Required

  • Hands-on experience defining and publishing SAP CDS Views from S/4HANA into Datasphere as the extraction layer
  • Experience setting up remote tables, replication flows, and data persistence layers within Datasphere
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory — maintaining pipelines, troubleshooting failures, and ensuring SLA adherence
  • Experience connecting SAP Datasphere to Power BI, including live connection, DirectQuery, and semantic model publishing
  • Experience with SAP BW, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, or comparable SAP analytics technologies
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise data integration solutions and data pipelines
  • Strong understanding of SAP data structures and business processes across modules such as Finance (FI), Controlling (CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), and Project Systems (PS)
  • Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT development, and cloud-based integration architectures
  • Strong SQL and data transformation skills within SAP Datasphere and HANA Cloud
  • Experience managing secure connectivity between SAP BDC and Azure — OAuth, service principals, SAP Integration Suite

Preferred

  • Experience with SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) implementation, administration, or support
  • Experience planning or executing data pipeline migrations — ideally from ADF or similar tools into a native SAP layer
  • Experience with SAP Datasphere and its integration capabilities within the SAP data ecosystem
  • Experience with SAP HANA Cloud and Core Data Services (CDS) modeling
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) as an alternative or complementary reporting layer
  • Familiarity with SAP BW/4HANA Open Hub as an alternative or legacy extraction mechanism
  • Experience with non-SAP analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Experience with Power BI dataflows, semantic models, and enterprise-scale report governance
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or other scripting languages for data transformation, automation, and analytics
  • SAP certifications related to SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA, or Business Data Cloud technologies

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a Sales Strategy and Operations Manager (IC) to partner directly with our sales leadership team to shape and execute Nebius’ go-to-market strategy and drive operational excellence across the full revenue lifecycle for our selling teams in the Americas market.

You will act as a strategic business partner to Sales leadership and support the execution of the go-to-market strategy through data-driven insights, process optimization, and operational excellence.

This role will own key processes related to quarterly planning cycles, territory alignment, forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and CRM governance. You will ensure operational consistency across the region and provide visibility into performance metrics that drive revenue outcomes.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional who combines strong analytical skills with structured thinking and execution rigor. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with large datasets, building dashboards, improving sales processes, and collaborating cross-functionally with Finance, Marketing, and GTM stakeholders.

You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.

You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Support Sales leadership in weekly forecast reviews and pipeline inspections
  • Maintain and improve forecast tracking models and reporting structures
  • Build and maintain dashboards in CRM / BI tools to monitor bookings, pipeline generation, conversion rates, and attainment
  • Ensure CRM data hygiene and enforce standardized pipeline management practices
  • Support territory alignment updates and account ownership changes
  • Assist in quarterly planning cycles (target tracking, headcount tracking, performance visibility)
  • Partner with Finance on revenue visibility and reporting alignment
  • Monitor lead routing logic and GTM workflows across HubSpot and Salesforce
  • Identify process gaps and propose operational improvements
  • Support documentation of GTM processes and internal playbooks
  • Assist with system enhancements and new tool rollouts
  • Provide ad-hoc analysis to support business decisions

We expect you to have:

  • 6-7+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a similar analytical function (preferably in Cloud, SaaS, or other technology)
  • Strong hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce and HubSpot)
  • Experience working with forecasting processes and pipeline reporting
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; experience working with large datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, scaling environment

Key employee benefits in the US:

  • Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

$137,600—$172,000 USD

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Strategy & Business Development

  • Own the global IDIRA strategy and business plan for NTT DATA, including growth priorities, target markets, sales motions, pipeline objectives, and execution milestones.

GTM & Pipeline Creation

  • Drive measurable IDIRA pipeline creation and revenue growth with NTT DATA globally.

  • Build and execute targeted sales plays with NTT DATA across priority industries, regions, and strategic accounts.

  • Work directly with Palo Alto Networks and NTT DATA field organizations to identify, qualify, develop, and accelerate IDIRA opportunities.

  • Establish account-mapping and opportunity-development programs that convert NTT DATA customer relationships and Palo Alto Networks installed-base intelligence into actionable pipeline.

  • Develop repeatable demand-generation and sales acceleration programs with regional teams.

  • Engage directly on strategic opportunities where partnership leadership, executive alignment, or cross-functional orchestration is required to advance or close the opportunity.

Solution & Capability Development

  • Partner with Palo Alto Networks Product, Product Management, Engineering, and technical teams to ensure NTT DATA understands the IDIRA strategy, roadmap, differentiation, and customer value proposition.

  • Coordinate certification, enablement, solution development, and field-readiness activities across relevant NTT DATA teams.

Global Execution & Governance

  • Translate the global IDIRA strategy into regional execution plans across NAM, EMEA, JAPAC, and LATAM.

  • Lead regular business reviews covering pipeline, bookings, sales plays, solution development, enablement, field engagement, risks, and required actions.

Required

Preferred Qualifications

As a Consultant at Harbor, you will engage with colleagues who are smart, innovative, and eager to meet new challenges. An entrepreneurial spirit and positive “can-do” attitude are the common threads that unites us to drive forward and succeed.

The Associate Consultant is an early-career professional who demonstrates the ability to contribute independently to client projects while continuing to build depth in technical and consulting expertise. Consultants are expected to balance strong client-service skills with growing technical proficiency, managing multiple deliverables in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

At this level, Consultants move beyond foundational execution by taking ownership of discrete workstreams, applying problem-solving skills to moderately complex challenges, and contributing to process improvements. They are relied upon to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders, maintain a high billable utilization rate, and adapt quickly to new technologies or shifting client needs. This role represents the transition from a support-focused contributor to an independent consultant who consistently delivers value while continuing to learn under the guidance of senior colleagues.

Responsibilities:

  • Communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively in both verbal and written formats with technical staff, business users, and management personnel.
  • Manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment, adapting to shifting priorities while maintaining quality and timeliness.
  • Build strong working relationships with colleagues and clients through advanced interpersonal skills and professional client service.
  • Apply strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to resolve moderately complex technical and functional challenges.
  • Quickly adopt new skills and adjust to challenging priorities, technologies, and client requirements.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of applications or integrations within defined frameworks.
  • Recognize recurring or moderately complex issues and contribute to the development of effective solutions with guidance from senior consultants.
  • Recommend improvements to tools, processes, or designs based on project experience and client feedback.
  • Support knowledge sharing by documenting lessons learned, contributing to process documentation, and assisting junior team members when possible.
  • Take ownership of focused client-facing workstreams or deliverables, ensuring completion on time and to a high standard.
  • Proactively provide updates to project leads and clients regarding task status, risks, or potential roadblocks.
  • Serve in a primarily client-facing capacity, participating on camera for client meetings and engaging in occasional in-person client interactions as requested.
  • Participate in solution design discussions, offering input based on practical project experience and emerging technical skills.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, attention to detail, and sound time management when managing client and internal deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • Have permanent US work authorization.
  • Open to remote applicants in US and Canada. Strong preference for Chicago-based applicants who can work up to 2-3 days per week from the Chicago office.

Responsabilidades principais:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de predição para o Zé Delivery.
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados e features em PySpark para suportar modelos em escala.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de recomendação de produtos e ofertas ao longo da jornada do consumidor.
  • Definir, executar e analisar testes A/B para avaliação de impacto de modelos e campanhas.

Domínio Técnico (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning para recomendação, predição e classificação.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de recomendação, como fatoração de matrizes (ex: ALS), modelos baseados em vizinhança e embeddings.

Diferenciais (Nice to Have):

  • Experiência com arquiteturas modernas de recomendação (ex: two-tower models, retrieval + ranking).
  • Experiência com embeddings de usuários e itens (ex: Word2Vec, item2vec, deep learning aplicado a recsys).
  • Vivência com sistemas de recomendação em tempo real e baixa latência.
  • Experiência com feature stores e serving de features online/offline.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de exploração vs. explotação (ex: multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning aplicado a recomendação).
  • Pós-graduação na área de Ciência de Dados ou correlatas (incluindo mestrado ou doutorado).

Location: Remote

Salary Range: $68,000 - $70,00 Per Year (Eligible for earning commissions upon successful contract renewals and adoption)

About The Fedcap Group

Founded in 1935, The Fedcap Group is a $425M global nonprofit organization focused on advancing economic well-being for individuals facing barriers to employment. Headquartered in New York City, Fedcap operates across 106 locations in 29 U.S. states, the U.K., Canada, and Australia serving nearly 332,000 people annually. Fedcap’s mission is to create opportunities for people facing barriers to achieve economic independence, dignity, and become contributing members of society. Through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, workforce development initiatives, and community-based services, Fedcap helps individuals build sustainable pathways to employment and long-term success.

About Single Stop

Mission: To build pathways out of poverty by leveraging partnerships and technology to connect people to existing resources, all through a unique one-stop shop.

Fueled by state-of-the-art technology, a world-class staff, and our education and nonprofit network partners, Single Stop's vision is for every individual to have access to opportunities for achieving the American Dream. We are working to connect individuals living in poverty to untapped local, state, and federal dollars and benefits to put them on the road to economic stability and prosperity.

Website:

Position Summary

As Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Single Stop, you will play a critical role in the overall success and satisfaction of our partners. You will be the main point of contact for our customers, ensuring that they are fully supported from onboarding to the ongoing use of Single Stop's technology. In addition, you will deliver personalized consulting services, design and lead training sessions, and ensure our partners maximize the impact of our solutions on the communities they serve. You will increase user adoption, mitigate churn, foster long-lasting, productive partnerships, and explore opportunities to expand our relationship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Onboarding & Training: Lead launch courses to onboard new partners to the Single Stop technology. Deliver training on best practices and provide ongoing support to ensure partners understand and effectively utilize the platform.
  • Relationship Management: Serve as the primary consultant to partners, helping them implement and optimize their use of Single Stop. Provide tailored consulting services and solutions to meet specific partner needs.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor partner performance using data analytics to track outcomes, assess the effectiveness of implementations, and recommend improvements. Provide regular feedback to partners based on their results.
  • Customer Retention, Success and Expansion: Work proactively to retain customers by maintaining high levels of partner satisfaction, troubleshooting issues, and resolving concerns. Actively engage with partners to renew contracts and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Business Development team to ensure a seamless transition for new partners. Partner with the Director of Customer Success to develop training content and optimize consulting services.
  • User Adoption & Churn Mitigation: Act as a thought leader within the organization by providing fresh, innovative ideas for increasing user adoption and reducing churn among partners.
  • Partner Engagement & Marketing: Collaborate with partners to develop and execute marketing plans that drive program awareness, participation, and impact.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • At least 2-3 years of experience developing and facilitating training and/or giving presentations to large and small groups (4-5 years preferred).
  • Previous experience at a SaaS company.
  • Experience in account management, including the ability to anticipate partner needs, analyze and evaluate performance metrics, and proactively recommend strategies for success.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population.
raw.description:
Company Overview
RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population. In 2010, Rethink launched its first solution, a suite of special needs and behavior management offerings, to support K-12 education. Over time, we expanded our offerings to support the entire behavioral health community by adding solutions in the employer (RethinkCare), provider (RethinkBH), and payor (RethinkFutures) industries, and to drive whole child wellness and success in education (RethinkEd).

Today, we’re proud to have almost 500 team members working to support over 2,000 customers worldwide as we work together to support our communities and help every individual reach their potential.
Over the past fifteen years, RethinkFirst’s mission has evolved to transform the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empowering all individuals with behavioral health challenges and those who support them. We continue to focus on the future of transforming behavioral health through data science, analytics, and enabling value-based care. With patent-pending solutions and the largest published ASD dataset, RethinkFirst can focus on improving outcomes and having a positive impact on the millions of lives it supports.

Rethink Billing Overview
Our Billing Services Division specializes in Revenue Cycle Management, Enrollment and Credentialing, and Benefit Authorization Management services. We are growing and are looking for new team members that will offer our clients best-in-class billing services. We support mission-oriented companies that impact the lives of thousands of individuals with autism and their families. We are excited to offer the opportunity for professional and collaborative individuals to grow and be part of something exciting.

Job Summary
The RCM Billing Specialist is responsible for supporting our billing teams by working with insurance companies to ensure efficient and prompt reimbursement for therapy sessions for our customers through timely and clean claim submission..

Job Duties:

  • Ensure strict HIPAA-compliant confidentiality with all client data and claims
  • Manage and operate in multiple different billing platforms dependent on client needs which could include Azalea, Tebra, Central Reach and/or Rethink Integrated Billing Module
  • Manage assigned client accounts billing scrubs for primary and secondary claims
  • Submit claims electronically for primary and secondary payors
  • Solve clearinghouse rejections
  • Submit corrected claims for billing errors, rebill projects (new plans/new year, new information on payor policies)
  • Maintain account spreadsheets, billing cheat sheets, provider, and billing information including provider roster and payer policy billing rules
  • Contribute to updates and communicate to Customer Billing Advocate and other members of POD
  • Provide internal reporting to team of status and issues for clients within POD
  • Meet internal benchmarks for clean claims / first pass rate, unbilled claims, clearinghouse rejections, secondary claims, and denials for billing errors
  • Research specific payor billing rules as needed
  • Review client billing documentation to ensure claims are submitted based on payor requirements
  • Stay informed about Payor and Industry Billing rules
  • Foster a positive work environment for team members
Requirements:
  • 1-2 years of billing experience in speech, occupational, and ABA therapy.
  • Strong knowledge of CPT coding and billing rules for major health insurance companies
  • Experience working directly with large insurance companies such as Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, Magellan, etc.
  • Proficiently using Billing Software and Clearinghouse systems
    (Azalea, Kareo, Waystar, TriZetto, Azalea, Central Reach).
  • Proficient using Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word).
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Previous ABA, Speech, OT, and Mental Health billing experience.
  • Minimum 1-2 years’ experience working in an office setting
  • Minimum 1 year experience in billing both major commercial insurance companies as well as state Medicaid programs
  • Experience using insurance company websites/portals
  • Proficient using Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word)
Education: 
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred/ HS Diploma or Equivalent required
Benefits:
  • PTO and Vacation Days after a 90-day introductory period
  • Paid Holidays
  • Generous Health, Denial & Vision benefits package
  • 401k + Matching

Job Type: Full-time, Hourly, Monday-Friday (9-6 PM)

Remote opportunities are available only in the following states:AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IA, MO, NC, NE, NY, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA

📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we een senior Data Governance Analyst die ondersteuning biedt bij de analyse, documentatie en implementatie van data governance. De focus ligt op het verbeteren van de vindbaarheid, begrijpbaarheid en kwaliteit van data.

  • Je brengt datasets, databronnen, metadata, datastromen, eigenaarschap en datakwaliteit in kaart.
  • Je analyseert waar informatie ontbreekt of onduidelijk is en documenteert je bevindingen op een heldere manier.
  • Je ondersteunt bij het identificeren en vastleggen van Data Owners, Data Stewards en andere betrokken rollen.
  • Je verzamelt input bij verschillende stakeholders en vertaalt die naar duidelijke overzichten, definities, procesbeschrijvingen en documentatie.
  • Je helpt datakwaliteitsproblemen, kwaliteitsregels en metadata-afspraken te documenteren en op te volgen.
  • Je registreert en onderhoudt relevante informatie in data catalog tooling.
  • Je werkt mee aan het concreet toepasbaar maken en implementeren van bestaande en nieuwe data governance-afspraken binnen data- en businessprocessen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ervaring met data-analyse, data governance, metadata management of data quality.
  • Je bent sterk in het verzamelen, analyseren en structureren van informatie.
  • Je vertaalt complexe informatie vlot naar duidelijke en bruikbare documentatie.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met data, moderne dataplatformen en AI-omgevingen.
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
  • Je pakt change pragmatisch aan en weet anderen mee te krijgen in nieuwe afspraken.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en consistent.
  • Ervaring met data catalog tooling is een plus.
  • Kennis van data governance-principes en relevante regelgeving, zoals GDPR, is een plus.
  • Ervaring binnen een data- of AI-omgeving is een plus.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Job Title: Command & Control Account Manager

Location: Remote – Based on the West Coast

Travel: 50–75%
Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Command & Control Account Manager with a proven track record in audiovisual (A/V) sales, specifically focused on command and control systems. This role is ideal for a sales professional who thrives on building relationships, driving business growth, and delivering complex technology solutions to clients in mission-critical environments. The position is remote, but requires extensive travel to customer sites and industry events.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage client relationships within the command & control, operations center, and mission-critical markets.
Drive new business development while managing and growing existing accounts.
Identify client needs and propose customized AV solutions, with a focus on command & control systems.
Collaborate with engineering, design, and project management teams to deliver solutions that meet customer requirements.
Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and presentations to proposal development, negotiation, and closing.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and client meetings.
Achieve and exceed sales targets and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

5+ years of proven sales experience in the audiovisual industry.
Strong background in A/V systems with a focus on command & control environments (operations centers, NOCs, SOCs, emergency response, defense, or similar).
Deep understanding of AV technologies such as video walls, signal processing, control systems, and visualization platforms.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage complex sales cycles and work with both technical and executive-level stakeholders.
Self-motivated and results-oriented with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (50–75%) across the West Coast and other regions as required.

Preferred Experience:

Existing client relationships within defense, public safety, utilities, or enterprise command & control markets.
Familiarity with manufacturers and technologies commonly used in control room solutions (e.g., Barco, Christie, Planar, Crestron, Extron, etc.).
Experience responding to RFPs and government/enterprise procurement processes.

Magnit is the future of work. Serving hundreds of the world’s most recognizable brands for the past 30+ years, Magnit offers the industry’s first holistic platform for the modern workforce. Magnit's integrated workforce management (IWM) platform supported by data, software, intelligence, and best-in-class services team is key to our clients’ success. At Magnit, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who collaborate and deliver meaningful results that positively transform the largest companies around the globe.

About the Role The Delivery Partner (DP) is responsible for the efficient delivery of Magnit’s services to our clients. Located on-site, this position will work closely with vendors, client hiring managers, and cross-functional teams, utilizing our award-winning software, Magnit VMS to ensure smooth service delivery. Location Remote- US Based Must work PST hours

What You Will Do

At Magnit,you’ll be joining an innovative, high-growth environment and can quickly make an impact to help transform the largest companies in the world. Magnit will offer you a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement planning, as well as discounts and perks for tickets, travel, merchandise and more! Magnit encourages employees to participate in giving back, and we will match employee contributions to favorite charities and support corporate volunteering hours to make a difference in your community!

Stay in touch, we will let you know when we have new positions on the team. To see a complete list of our open career opportunities please visit

Continuous Learning and Innovation

Collaboration

  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail.
