raw.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer I at Trader Interactive, you will contribute to the implementation of foundational product features, writing high-quality, secure, and maintainable code under technical guidance. You will be responsible for adhering to established development standards, managing individual task delivery, and writing robust unit tests to ensure application health. Collaborating closely within your engineering team, you will focus on building your domain expertise, absorbing code review feedback, and proactively aligning technical execution with the team's immediate delivery goals. In this role, the Software Engineer I actively develops their technical skill set and fosters collaborative peer connections, contributing to the steady execution and success of the task force.

  • Consistently write and maintain secure, maintainable, readable, and testable code under supervision, ensuring all deliverables strictly meet relevant acceptance criteria and the team's Definition of Done.

  • Implement basic features and core functions within a software component while building an introductory understanding of the broader component architecture and standard design patterns.

  • Adhere closely to established team development standards, style guides, and coding best practices, incorporating code review feedback loops, including critically reviewing AI-generated code before submission, to optimize technical execution.

  • Identify, report, and debug technical issues within familiar codebases and local systems, collaborating actively with peers and utilizing standard team troubleshooting workflows to resolve blockers quickly.

  • Actively participate in unit testing efforts and automated testing setups with engineering guidance, aligning code output with the organization's testing pyramid objectives.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools (such as AI code assistants) to accelerate routine coding, testing, and debugging tasks, always validating generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability before use.

  • Engage in foundational innovation and domain growth by sharing useful execution ideas, researching team systems, and pursuing stretch assignments to expand overall domain knowledge.

  • Observe and collaborate with senior team members to learn task breakdown methodologies, aiming to provide reliable, data-backed effort estimations for individual deliverables.

  • Proactively identify, escalate, and communicate dependencies, technical friction, or blockers within personal scope to mitigate delivery risks early.

  • Demonstrate standard operational awareness by learning the organization's core monitoring philosophies and observing system health data relative to the team's domain.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with TypeScript.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., AI code assistants), and a willingness to use them responsibly to improve productivity.

  • Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git), and understanding of software development workflows.

  • Understanding of software design principles, such as object-oriented programming and software architecture.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug simple issues and seek help when needed.

  • Willingness to learn and adapt, demonstrating initiative in mastering new technologies and improving existing skill sets.

  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

Bonus Points

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Role Scope:

The Senior Real Estate Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the organization's real estate portfolio, ensuring assets are optimized for financial performance, operational efficiency, legal compliance, and alignment with broader business objectives. This role leads acquisition, disposition, leasing, portfolio planning, and acting as the primary liaison with landlords, tenants, brokers, and internal stakeholders.

Develop and execute the organization's real estate strategy, including portfolio planning, site selection, expansion, consolidation, and exit strategies aligned with business growth and cost objectives.

  • Lead site selection for new locations, including partnering with brokers to source properties, participating in site visits, and comprehensively evaluating candidate properties against business criteria.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of leasing activity: negotiating new leases, renewals, rent reviews, subleases, and lease terminations across the portfolio.
  • Oversee acquisitions and disposals of owned property, including due diligence, valuation review, negotiation, and coordination with legal counsel through to closing.
  • Lead landlord, tenant, and broker relationships, serving as the primary point of contact and escalation for lease and property-related matters.
  • Ensure all properties comply with applicable zoning, building codes, health and safety regulations, environmental requirements, and lease covenants.
  • Analyze market trends, comparable transactions, and portfolio performance data to inform space planning, rent benchmarking, and investment decisions.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, HR, and Operations on space planning, occupancy cost allocation, workplace strategy, and business continuity planning.
  • Prepare and present business cases, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and, where relevant, the Board.
  • Develop and maintain lease abstracts, critical date trackers, and portfolio documentation to ensure timely action on options, renewals, and expirations.
  • Benchmark occupancy costs, service charges, and utility spend against market data to identify savings opportunities.
  • Manage relationships with local authorities, planning bodies, and utility providers as required for permits, approvals, and site works.
  • Support workplace change initiatives, including office relocations, fit-outs, and space utilization studies.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5 years of real estate developmentexperience
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including lease economics and capital planning.
  • Excellent negotiation, contract management, and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking balanced with hands-on operational problem-solving.
  • Effective project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sites and priorities simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of real estate law, lease structures, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
  • Understanding of local and regional real estate markets, valuation methods, and transaction structures.
  • Knowledge of building codes, health and safety regulations, and environmental compliance standards.
  • Awareness of risk management principles, including insurance, liability, and disaster recovery planning as applied to real estate.

Nice to Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, real estate, or related field (or equivalent experience).

The anticipated base salary range for this position annually is:San Franciso, NYC, Seattle - $153,000 - $170,000 / All other locations -$138,000 - $162,000

This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

Job Description

The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Individualized Therapy Operations, the Associate Director, Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) Lead is responsible for leading the centralized operational coordination capability that supports execution of the Intismeran treatment journey.

This leader will build, develop, and oversee a team of Treatment Site Operations Coordinators (TSOCs) responsible for coordinating patient cases, managing operational workflows, facilitating communication across stakeholders, and ensuring timely progression of patients through key treatment journey milestones. The role serves as the primary operational bridge between Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, patient support programs, and internal teams.

The TSOC team functions as the centralized coordination hub for the treatment journey, providing operational visibility, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and case-level support to ensure patients successfully progress through each stage of the individualized therapy process. This role is accountable for establishing consistent operational standards, escalation pathways, and ways of working that enable seamless coordination across the treatment ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Build, lead, and develop the Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) organization, establishing team structure, performance expectations, ways of working, and capabilities required to support launch readiness and future scale.

  • Lead centralized operational coordination across the treatment journey, ensuring effective communication and alignment among treatment sites, Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, alliance stakeholders, and internal teams.

  • Oversee the centralized case management capability, including active patient case coordination, operational escalations, cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring timely communication and resolution of issues that may impact treatment completion.

  • Establish and manage operational escalation processes, proactively identifying, triaging, escalating, and resolving operational issues that may impact customer experience, treatment completion, or therapy delivery timelines.

  • Drive visibility and transparency across the treatment ecosystem, providing timely status updates, operational communications, and stakeholder coordination throughout the treatment journey.

  • Partner with the Individualized Therapy Operations team, Treatment Site Strategy team, TSL leadership, Patient Support, and IT to identify and resolve operational barriers, improve stakeholder experiences, and drive continuous improvement across the treatment journey.

  • Establish and monitor operational service standards, performance expectations, and response timelines for the TSOC organization to ensure consistent execution and a high-quality treatment site experience.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, treatment site experience, execution consistency, and treatment completion, incorporating customer feedback and operational insights to improve future performance.

Education:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (BA/BS)

MBA or equivalent preferred

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry, including experience supporting treatment operations, patient operations, customer operations, treatment site operations, commercial operations, or other cross-functional operational functions.

  • Experience leading customer-facing operations, patient services, hub services, or customer support organizations, with a strong understanding of customer experience and operational issue resolution.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating activities across multiple internal teams and external stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to manage operational escalations, resolve complex issues, and drive alignment across different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong operational execution, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience establishing operational processes, workflows, service standards, and performance expectations that support consistent execution and customer experience.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively communicate across field teams, treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, vendors, and leadership teams.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and operational excellence.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting the commercialization of complex therapies, including, cell therapy, gene therapy, radioligand therapy, or other highly coordinated treatment models.

  • Experience working directly with treatment sites, hospitals, academic medical centers, community oncology practices, or integrated delivery networks.

  • Experience with treatment journey orchestration platforms, workflow technologies, customer support systems, case management platforms, or operational control towers.

Communication Management, Customer Engagement, Customer Feedback, Customer Management, Market Development, Patient Services, People Leadership, Product Launch Support, Product Management, Work Management

Talent Acquisition Specialist

At INTEGRITYOne Partners (IOP), we are a federal technology company focused on DevSecOps and agile software development, analytics and AI, cloud engineering, and data management. Our people are known for being technical Swiss army knives that are depended on by our clients to support a myriad of highly complex, technical problems within rapidly changing missions. We enable federal law enforcement clients to execute high-tempo, mission-critical work that ultimately improves the lives of the people they serve. Our culture is entrepreneurial, mission-first, and meritocratic, giving you direct access to decision-makers and real influence over how we win and deliver.


Job Description
INTEGRITYOne Partners is seeking a motivated, resourceful, and self-starting Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for full-cycle recruiting activities supporting current program needs, strategic growth initiatives, and proposal efforts within the federal government contracting space. This person will report directly to the Manager of People Operations.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships with technical professionals, and can effectively partner with hiring managers to attract and hire top talent. This individual will play a key role in supporting IOP's continued growth by identifying exceptional candidates, delivering a positive candidate experience, and helping build high-performing teams that support mission-critical government programs.

Location This position is remote; however, candidates located in Maryland, Washington, D.C., or Virginia are preferred.

Key Responsibilities:
Full-Cycle Technical Recruitment
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical and professional positions, from requisition intake through offer acceptance and pre-onboarding.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring priorities, technical requirements, and workforce planning needs.
  • Conduct candidate screenings, interviews, and assessments to evaluate qualifications, experience, and overall fit.
  • Coordinate and facilitate interviews while ensuring efficient and positive candidate experience.
Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development
  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to identify qualified candidates.
  • Build and maintain pipelines of cleared technical talent for current and future hiring needs.
  • Proactively engage passive candidates and cultivate long-term relationships within targeted talent communities.
  • Leverage LinkedIn, JazzHR, professional networks, employee referrals, and other creative sourcing channels to identify qualified cleared talent.
Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, recruiting activity, and hiring metrics within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Support the development and refinement of the recruiting processes, workflows, and documentation to drive efficiency and consistency.
  • Draft and update job descriptions that align with position requirements and federal contract needs.
  • Monitor recruiting metrics and provide insights on sourcing effectiveness, hiring trends, and process improvements to leadership team.
Business Growth Support
  • Partner with leadership to support proposal recruitment efforts and identify contingent candidates for upcoming opportunities.
  • Assist with workforce planning activities for new programs, contract transitions, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify, engage, and maintain relationships with contingent candidates to support proposal submissions, anticipated contract awards, and future staffing needs.
  • Stay informed on market trends, compensation considerations, security clearance requirements, and emerging recruiting best practices within the federal contracting industry.
People Operations Support
  • Provide support to the People Operations team with onboarding, employee communications, and other people-related initiatives as needed.
  • Assist with onboarding and new hire administrative processes, including coordination of required documentation and pre-employment activities.
  • Support the coordination of People Operations projects, programs, and administrative activities as needed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4-6 years of technical recruiting in the federal government contracting space.
  • Experience recruiting technical roles such as DevSecOps, software development, cloud, data analytics, digital modernization, engineering, and IT operations.
  • Familiarity with talent-acquisition best practices in a high-growth environment.
  • Knowledge of federal government contracting and security clearance processes preferred.
  • Knowledge of recruiting and employment requirements within the federal government contracting environment.
  • Experience managing ATS platforms (preferably JazzHR), sourcing tools, and recruiting technologies to manage candidate pipelines and hiring activity.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisitions while meeting hiring timelines.
Salary range: $75,000-$85,000

At INTEGRITYOne Partners, we hold ourselves and our team members to high standards—and when our people meet those standards, the personal and professional rewards are meaningful. We are committed to helping our employees grow their careers by providing opportunities to build valuable Federal knowledge and experience, develop in-demand skills, strengthen their professional capabilities, and access targeted education and training.

INTEGRITYOne Partners is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy to provide equal opportunity to each individual without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, family responsibility, pregnancy, political affiliation or any other status protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, benefits, promotion or termination. At MissionWired, we help our partners create revolutionary fundraising strategies that advance their mission, change our country, and have a positive impact on the world.
We help our partners tell big, ambitious stories that invite their supporters into communities to raise mission-changing revenue. We do it over email and SMS, in the mail, across social media, everywhere. We don’t think in terms of channels; we’re single-minded in pursuit of your success.
We’re innovative, progress-obsessed, do-gooders who care deeply about social change and continuing to push the limits on what we can accomplish together. We’ve brought strategies to life for nonprofit organizations working around the world, including Human Rights Watch, The Humane Society of the U.S., Save the Children, and Friends of the Earth. Over the years, we have worked with various progressive political organizations and believe that each election cycle is an opportunity for us to support organizations across the country and elect Democrats to legislative bodies up and down the ballot.
We’re an equal-opportunity employer and take seriously our commitment to equality and equity. Our efforts to be inclusive and create opportunity don’t end when someone joins us – they begin. We’ve set our sights on changing the world through our work and with our clients, and representation is at the foundation of what we do. We know that diversity of thought and background makes us stronger. That’s why we’re committed to building and maintaining a diverse community.
Every new team member broadens our perspective and allows us to think bigger. We’ll be at our best when people from underrepresented communities and people with a range of perspectives and lived experiences want to come, stay, and push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Please note: we may not be actively hiring for this team, however, when we are, you may be the first to hear from us!
Does the idea for transforming millions of data points into unparalleled opportunities – supporting everything from electing Democrats to combating climate change throughout the world, sound exciting to you? Then you're in the right place! On our data and product teams, you'll be driving positive change alongside a team of data scientists and engineers developing first-of-their-kind machine-learning products. With us, you’ll put your skills to use for disruptive innovation that powers social good.
You’ll join a product team that is deeply devoted to inclusion, particularly in the following three areas:
Process: We create a context in which everyone is empowered to contribute.
Data-Driven: We are committed to using the power of data to support important causes.
Philanthropy: We empower diverse groups of individuals to participate in giving.
We want your ideas and your leadership. Join us. Let’s go!

Teams available for this resume pool:

  • Engineering (Data, Software, ML)
  • Data Science
  • Data Analysis
  • Product Management
  • Project Management
  • Full-Stack Web Development
  • This may not be a holistic list and is subject to change as new positions are added to the data and product teams.

  • Joining each and every one of your colleagues in creating an inclusive workspace;
  • Using an array of technological languages, models, and tools;
  • Working toward constantly improving data reliability and quality;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support their data related needs.

Must-have qualifications:

  • Attention to detail;
  • Intellectual curiosity to innovate on ways to solve data management issues;
  • Passion, energy, and excitement for progressive and philanthropic causes and all things digital.

Nice-to-have qualifications (depending on the role):

  • Python, Pandas, PySpark, SQL, R;
  • Familiarity with big data tools using AWS or other cloud services;
  • A passion for statistical methodology;
  • Experience with MLOps platforms like MLFlow, Sagemaker, and/or Google Cloud AI;
  • Experience in coding and/or analytics;
  • Experience in building data- and/or machine learning-based products;
  • A background in related industry sectors.
If hired on a full-time salaried basis then this position may be included in a union-represented collective bargaining unit, and specific employment terms and conditions are subject to collective bargaining.
Location
We are currently working remotely with no return to office date. Applicants may reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MD, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WA. Due to FL legislation, MissionWired is required to participate in e-verify.

Benefits

100% employer-paid premiums for platinum-level medical plan on a national health care network
100% employer-paid life insurance and short term disability
50% employer-paid vision and dental insurance
401(k) with 3% employer contribution
20 vacation days in addition to 12 paid holidays, sick days, bereavement leave, and a volunteer day off.
Paid parental leave at 100% of your salary
Financial support for reproductive and transgender care
Flexible telecommute and remote work policies
Company issued Mac products for home offices
Cell phone service reimbursement, meal and ride-share reimbursement, and other perks available
*Supporting your team on some nights and weekends as we approach high-volume times such as elections may be required.

Saving the World! Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises. We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We have an opportunity for a motivated individual to fill the role of Project Administrator. In this position, the successful candidate will support the HVAC Field Operations Team, which includes the Special Projects Team, UHP Team, Quality Assurance Team, and Project Managers, by helping keep projects organized, schedules coordinated, and communication flowing between stakeholders. Responsibilities may include monitoring procurement, fulfillment, and shipping activities; assisting with schedule management; coordinating communication between teams, contractors, and customers; creating and verifying work order data; creating tickets for installation support; tracking and updating project status; closing out work orders; and helping resolve customer or project-related issues as they arise.

Why This Role Is Important:
The Project Administrator plays a key support role in helping the HVAC Field Operations Team and other internal teams stay aligned throughout the project lifecycle. This role helps ensure administrative tasks, schedules, documentation, coordination, and follow-ups are completed accurately and efficiently, allowing internal teams to remain focused on successful project execution and customer outcomes.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Assist with the creation and assignment of project work orders (WOs) for contractors and internal teams.

About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Program Manager to support business operations, strategic initiatives, and program governance within a fast-paced technology environment. In this role, you will own recurring business rhythms, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, maintain critical team resources and knowledge repositories, and help ensure programs operate efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with senior stakeholders, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of projects with minimal oversight. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to improve operational processes, support strategic initiatives, and lead projects from planning through execution.

  • Manage recurring business rhythms, leadership meetings, and operational cadences, including agendas, materials, action items, and follow-up.

  • Track project dependencies, deliverables, decisions, and action items to ensure accountability and timely execution.
  • Build, maintain, and organize team SharePoint sites and other knowledge-management resources.
  • Own and continuously improve onboarding documentation, processes, and team resources.
  • Maintain team documentation repositories, knowledge bases, and collaboration tools, including OneNote.
  • Coordinate management information and reporting to ensure leadership receives timely and accurate updates.
  • Support resource planning, forecasting, and tracking as needed across projects and programs.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify operational gaps and implement process improvements.
  • Coordinate and, where appropriate, lead meetings, forums, and working sessions in support of program objectives.
  • Support colleagues with program processes, tools, documentation standards, and knowledge-management practices.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in program management, project management, or a closely related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting business operations, program administration, and/or executive stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with SharePoint administration and knowledge management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing recurring business rhythms, governance forums, leadership meetings, or operational cadences.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage dependencies, track action items, and drive accountability.
  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, meeting materials, and executive-facing communications.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and changing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret information and translate it into actionable insights.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of operating independently with minimal oversight.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting senior leadership teams in a large, complex technology or enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining SharePoint sites.
  • Experience managing OneNote notebooks, team documentation repositories, or centralized knowledge bases.
  • Understanding of information architecture, content organization, and content-governance best practices.
  • Experience developing or improving onboarding programs and supporting documentation.
  • Experience standardizing or automating operational processes to improve team productivity.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office and common project/program management tools.
  • Experience supporting resource planning, forecasting, budget/spend tracking, or related operational reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for operational improvement and independently lead solutions through implementation.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $23 to $25 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Job Description:

The World Trade Center Health Program is a limited federal health program administered by the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), part of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). The Program provides no-cost medical monitoring and treatment for certified WTC-related health conditions to those directly affected by the 9/11 attacks in New York, the Pentagon, and in Shanksville, Pennsylvania.

Own your opportunity to turn data into measurable outcomes for our customers’ most complex challenges. As a Healthcare Business Intelligence Analyst at GDIT, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to power your career forward.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Healthcare Business Intelligence Analyst, the work you’ll do at GDIT will directly support the mission of the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP) Third Party Administrator analytics team. You will play a crucial role in ensuring program leadership, business teams, and government stakeholders receive accurate, timely, and actionable reporting used to guide operational and healthcare decisions.

● Support the development, updates, and maintenance of Power BI dashboards covering enrollment, claims, utilization, program performance, healthcare costs, and compliance metrics.
● Collaborate with report developers, analytics leadership, data engineers, database administrators, and business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, review results, and resolve data discrepancies.
● Drive reporting accuracy by performing data validation, documenting business rules, maintaining report inventories, and assisting with report migration and user acceptance testing.
● Utilize Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Query, Azure SQL, SQL queries, and Azure DevOps to prepare data, update reporting models, organize documentation, test reports, and track work within established development standards.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Healthcare Business Intelligence Analyst must have:

● Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science
● Experience: 2+ years of related experience
● Technical skills: Power BI, Power Query, SQL, relational databases, data validation, reporting documentation, Azure DevOps; familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and Azure SQL preferred
● Security clearance level: Ability to meet applicable contract suitability and access requirements

● US citizenship required

  • Role requirements: Ability to follow strict privacy, access, and data handling requirements; experience validating reports, documenting findings, supporting testing, and performing analytics tasks within a structured development environment

    GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
    At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

    ● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
    ● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
    ● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
    ● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
    ● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

    OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
    Explore a career in data and analytics at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your determination for solving complex data challenges.

raw.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - AI Innovation
raw.excerpt: Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box.
raw.description:
Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.

Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4.5/5-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026.

With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!

The Role:

As Principal PMM, you'll own the overarching AI and Orchestration Innovation narrative for Iterable, connecting individual capabilities into a single, compelling point of view on where AI-driven customer engagement is headed and why Iterable wins.

You'll drive Iterable's Tier 1 launches, our flagship releases that establish category leadership, earn analyst and press attention, and give the go-to-market org a unifying story to sell against. Key Responsibilities

Own the AI Narrative

  • Define and evolve Iterable's overarching AI point of view, which is the connective story that links individual capabilities into a coherent AI story and why we win there.
  • Translate deep technical understanding of how our AI actually works (models, agentic workflows, data/orchestration architecture) into customer value that resonates with both practitioners and executives.

Craft Messaging

  • Craft bold, narrative-driven messaging and positioning that connects AI and orchestration innovation to tangible customer value.
  • Write the Tier 1 launch messaging for flagship AI releases, setting the story every other asset needs to ladder back to.
  • Review and give direction on launch content and campaigns across the team, ensuring every asset ladders back to the launch narrative rather than drifting into its own

Market Intelligence

  • Conduct ongoing research into AI market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to sharpen and stress-test Iterable's AI point of view
  • Partner with product management to ensure the AI narrative reflects real market shifts and informs roadmap decisions

Adoption & Customer Success

  • Drive customer adoption and expansion of AI capabilities through lifecycle messaging and targeted enablement
  • Partner with customer marketing and CS on reference stories and case studies that prove out the AI narrative with real customers

Required Qualifications:

  • 8–10+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company, including ownership of Tier 1 bundled product releases. Prior martech experience is a plus.
  • Experience marketing an AI-native or agentic product, or a platform transitioning from feature-based to AI-managed experiences
  • Exceptional storytelling: a track record of shaping the strategic "why" behind a launch and translating it into messaging that sells
  • Deep, genuine understanding of how AI works, including models, agentic systems, and data architecture, with the ability to translate that into clear, differentiated customer narratives
  • A genuinely AI-forward PMM who is redefining what product marketing looks like by using AI tools in creative, non-obvious ways across research, messaging, and content development
  • Executive presence: comfortable operating as a strategic peer to senior Product and GTM leaders, with sound independent judgment and limited need for oversight

Success Metrics:

  • Market awareness, pipeline, and revenue influence across Tier 1 release launches
  • Adoption and expansion of AI capabilities across the customer base
  • Executive and analyst recognition of Iterable's AI point of view

Perks & Benefits:

  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive salaries, meaningful equity, & 401(k) plan
  • Medical, dental, vision, & life insurance
  • Community Impact Days
  • Fertility & Adoption Assistance
  • Paid Sabbatical
  • Flexible PTO
  • Monthly Employee Wellness allowance
  • Monthly Professional Development allowance
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Complete laptop workstation

raw.title: Technical Partnership Manager
raw.excerpt: Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr.
raw.description:
Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.

Job Description

Postscript is the leading AI-powered conversational commerce platform for Shopify brands, trusted by 20,000+ stores. We're all-in on SMS with one goal: make it the #1 revenue channel for the merchants we serve. Backed by Greylock, Y Combinator, and other top investors, we're growing fast and looking for remarkable people to help build a world-class organization.

Merchants don't run Postscript in isolation. They run it alongside a stack of loyalty, subscription, reviews, support, and data tools — and the connections between those tools are where a lot of untapped revenue sits. This role owns that surface area.

Reporting into Marketing and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, the Technical Partnership Manager builds and grows Postscript's technology partner ecosystem. You'll find the partnerships worth making, scope what it actually takes to build them, and make sure each one turns into demand rather than a logo on a page. It's a rare hybrid: you need the commercial instincts to size an opportunity and the technical depth to be credible with a partner's engineering team.

Here's the thing — most partnership roles are one or the other. This one isn't.

Primary Duties

  • Own a portfolio of technology and integration partners end to end: sourcing, evaluation, technical scoping, launch, and ongoing growth.
  • Identify and size partnership opportunities using real inputs — shared merchant overlap, attach rate, revenue impact, and build-and-maintain cost — and make a clear recommendation on what we should and shouldn't pursue.
  • Lead technical discovery with partners: understand their API surface, data model, and architecture well enough to scope a viable integration and flag risks early.
  • Translate partner opportunities into written specs and business cases that Product can act on, and represent the ecosystem's needs in roadmap conversations.
  • Partner with Marketing to turn every launch into demand — co-marketing, joint content, app listings, webinars, and events.
  • Build the enablement layer so Sales, Solutions, and Support can sell and service integrations confidently.
  • Serve as the escalation point for partner technical issues, triaging what Support handles, what Product needs to see, and what you can resolve yourself.
  • Own the number. You'll carry quarterly goals for partner-influenced pipeline and integration adoption, set in tandem with leadership.
  • Build the operating system for this function — tiering framework, partner agreements in concert with Legal, review cadence, and reporting.

What We'll Love About You

  • 4+ years in technical partnerships, partner/solutions engineering, technical account management, product marketing, or a similar role where you owned both a commercial outcome and a technical conversation.
  • You're technical enough to be dangerous: comfortable reading API docs, reasoning about webhooks and data flows, poking at a sandbox, and holding your own with a partner's engineering team. You don't need to ship production code, and we won't ask you to.
  • You've sized an opportunity and talked your own team out of a partnership. You know that a long partner list isn't the same as revenue.
  • Experience in ecommerce or martech is strongly preferred; Shopify ecosystem experience is a real advantage.
  • You write well. Specs, business cases, and partner briefs are the job, not the overhead.
  • You've influenced a product roadmap without owning it, and you can explain how.
  • High attention to detail with a process- and solution-oriented mindset — you leave behind systems, not just relationships.
  • A demonstrated record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Experience with CRM and partner/opportunity management systems, preferably Salesforce.
  • Willingness and ability to travel, up to 20%.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Salary range of USD $120,000 to $146,000 base plus variable compensation(30%) and equity regardless of location.
  • High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career!
  • Work from home (or wherever)
  • Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Health, dental, vision insurance

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

raw.excerpt: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life.
raw.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Heart Failure

In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the VAD Account Executive, you’ll have the chance to work with hospitals selling our Driveline Supply services, external equipment, and remote patient monitoring services.

What You’ll Work On

  • Ensures overall growth for assigned territory by meeting or exceeding defined New Driveline, Equipment, and Digital adoption goals
  • Focuses on depth penetration within key customer opportunities as defined by company goals through the use of compelling and influential sales conversations.
  • Applied Integrity Selling to assist key customers in understanding their needs and moving effectively and swiftly on a path toward achieving customer goals for successful outcomes.
  • Initiates compelling clinical, evidence-based, and business-based sales conversations with all customer call points regarding Acelis Connected Health service offerings.
  • Provides consultative insight into professional practices and efficiencies using data management.
  • Demonstrates consistency, proficiency, and accuracy in daily use of operating systems directly related to specific job function (including Salesforce.com, Concur, Outlook).
  • Works with multiple internal functional areas (Marketing, Sales, Clinical/Training, Operations) in planning and coordination of growth efforts and initiatives.
  • Provides professional consultative reports to build collaborative results-oriented relationships with key Customers & provides patient educational resources.
  • Uses sales and negotiating experience to overcome barriers to adoption of prospective customers resulting in remote monitoring program development and expansion.
  • Provides simple service and product presentation demonstrations as needed.
  • Maintains courteous and respectful working relation with all sales and service partners and all teammates.
  • Maintains professional working relationship with manufacturer representatives.
  • Follows all regulatory policies and procedures, privacy and security standards in accordance with government agencies to include HIPAA requirements.
  • Participates in development opportunities and on-going training.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Business School certification or one to three years of related experience in Medical, DME, or Pharmaceutical.
  • Ability to make decisions while following company procedures and governmental guidelines.
  • Ability to utilize available time to organize and complete work within given deadlines.
  • Communicate both in writing & verbally in a clear, professional, and concise manner.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to use critical thinking and reasoning skills to solve problems.
  • Attend job related courses & seminars as required.
  • Ability to use equipment that is relevant to job functions and requirements.
  • Ability to travel as required to perform job functions.
  • Organize activities or projects and meet set deadlines.
  • Ability to lift 15-20 pounds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with traveling, position requires 80% travel.
  • Applicable experience with Acelis Connected Health or Abbott.
  • Experience with mainstream office software including MS Windows, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com
  • Detail oriented
  • Persuasive and influential
  • Sales skills & aptitude
  • Professional demeanor via phone and in person
  • Strong computer/software skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Organization/time Management skills
  • Human relations skills

Apply Now

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

The base pay for this position is

$83,300.00 – $166,600.00

In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

Sales Force

HF Heart Failure

United States of America : Remote

Standard

Yes, 25 % of the Time

Not Applicable

The Role:

As Principal PMM, you'll own the overarching AI and Orchestration Innovation narrative for Iterable, connecting individual capabilities into a single, compelling point of view on where AI-driven customer engagement is headed and why Iterable wins.

You'll drive Iterable's Tier 1 launches, our flagship releases that establish category leadership, earn analyst and press attention, and give the go-to-market org a unifying story to sell against. Key Responsibilities

Own the AI Narrative

Craft Messaging

Market Intelligence

Adoption & Customer Success

raw.excerpt: Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr.
raw.description:
Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.

Job Description

Postscript is the leading AI-powered conversational commerce platform for Shopify brands, trusted by 20,000+ stores. We're all-in on SMS with one goal: make it the #1 revenue channel for the merchants we serve. Backed by Greylock, Y Combinator, and other top investors, we're growing fast and looking for remarkable people to help build a world-class organization.

Merchants don't run Postscript in isolation. They run it alongside a stack of loyalty, subscription, reviews, support, and data tools — and the connections between those tools are where a lot of untapped revenue sits. This role owns that surface area.

Reporting into Marketing and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, the Technical Partnership Manager builds and grows Postscript's technology partner ecosystem. You'll find the partnerships worth making, scope what it actually takes to build them, and make sure each one turns into demand rather than a logo on a page. It's a rare hybrid: you need the commercial instincts to size an opportunity and the technical depth to be credible with a partner's engineering team.

Here's the thing — most partnership roles are one or the other. This one isn't.

Primary Duties

  • Own a portfolio of technology and integration partners end to end: sourcing, evaluation, technical scoping, launch, and ongoing growth.
  • Identify and size partnership opportunities using real inputs — shared merchant overlap, attach rate, revenue impact, and build-and-maintain cost — and make a clear recommendation on what we should and shouldn't pursue.
  • Lead technical discovery with partners: understand their API surface, data model, and architecture well enough to scope a viable integration and flag risks early.
  • Translate partner opportunities into written specs and business cases that Product can act on, and represent the ecosystem's needs in roadmap conversations.
  • Partner with Marketing to turn every launch into demand — co-marketing, joint content, app listings, webinars, and events.
  • Build the enablement layer so Sales, Solutions, and Support can sell and service integrations confidently.
  • Serve as the escalation point for partner technical issues, triaging what Support handles, what Product needs to see, and what you can resolve yourself.
  • Own the number. You'll carry quarterly goals for partner-influenced pipeline and integration adoption, set in tandem with leadership.
  • Build the operating system for this function — tiering framework, partner agreements in concert with Legal, review cadence, and reporting.

What We'll Love About You

  • 4+ years in technical partnerships, partner/solutions engineering, technical account management, product marketing, or a similar role where you owned both a commercial outcome and a technical conversation.
  • You're technical enough to be dangerous: comfortable reading API docs, reasoning about webhooks and data flows, poking at a sandbox, and holding your own with a partner's engineering team. You don't need to ship production code, and we won't ask you to.
  • You've sized an opportunity and talked your own team out of a partnership. You know that a long partner list isn't the same as revenue.
  • Experience in ecommerce or martech is strongly preferred; Shopify ecosystem experience is a real advantage.
  • You write well. Specs, business cases, and partner briefs are the job, not the overhead.
  • You've influenced a product roadmap without owning it, and you can explain how.
  • High attention to detail with a process- and solution-oriented mindset — you leave behind systems, not just relationships.
  • A demonstrated record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Experience with CRM and partner/opportunity management systems, preferably Salesforce.
  • Willingness and ability to travel, up to 20%.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Salary range of USD $120,000 to $146,000 base plus variable compensation(30%) and equity regardless of location.
  • High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career!
  • Work from home (or wherever)
  • Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Health, dental, vision insurance

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

Role Summary

The Associate Director, Publishing provides strategic leadership for the PLOS journal portfolio, ensuring that portfolio priorities, publishing investments, and journal development strategies align with organizational goals and advance PLOS's mission.

Reporting to the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations, the Associate Director leads and develops a team of Publishers responsible for the performance and strategic development of journals portfolios. The Associate Director serves as the primary steward of portfolio-wide publishing performance, translating organizational strategy into clear priorities and ensuring effective coordination across the organization.

The Associate Director uses publishing data, financial information, market intelligence, and research community insight to guide strategic decisions, establish priorities, identify opportunities for growth and innovation, and manage risks. Working in partnership with the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations, the Associate Director ensures that journal-level strategies collectively support a sustainable PLOS portfolio with a strong value proposition.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Lead, develop, and support a team of senior publishing professionals responsible for journal and subject portfolio performance.
  • Establish clear goals, priorities, and measures of accountability that align with organizational and portfolio strategy.
  • Provide coaching, professional development, succession planning, and performance management for direct reports.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Work with Publishers to ensure effective leadership and development of Journal Development Managers and other publishing staff.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy and Performance

  • Develop and implement a portfolio-wide publishing strategy aligned with PLOS's mission and organizational objectives.
  • Ensure that journal and subject portfolio strategies collectively support a clear and differentiated value proposition for the PLOS portfolio.
  • Lead regular portfolio reviews and develop recommendations regarding journal positioning, growth opportunities, performance, and future direction.
  • Balance the needs of individual journals and research communities with broader portfolio and organizational objectives.
  • Support Publishers in identifying and responding to changes in research communities, funding policies, scholarly communication, and the publishing market.
  • Develop consistent approaches and decision-making frameworks for evaluating proposals, opportunities, and performance across the portfolio.
  • Guide the evaluation and development of new journals, products, services, publishing models in line with PLOS’s strategic direction.

Strategic and Business Leadership

  • Translate organizational strategy into clear portfolio priorities, objectives, and plans for the publishing team.
  • Oversee publishing budgets and forecasts in partnership with the Director and Publishers, ensuring responsible decision-making and effective resource allocation.
  • Act as a thought partner to, and deputize for, the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations when appropriate.
  • In close collaboration with colleagues in Editorial, Sales and Global Publishing Development, support publishers in developing impactful relationships with Editors-in-Chief, Editorial Board members, researchers, institutions, societies, and partner organizations.
  • Build productive partnerships across Editorial, Publishing Operations, Sales & Global Publishing Development, Product, Technology, Marketing, Finance, Research Integrity, and other organizational teams.
  • Work with Editorial and Publishing Operations leaders to ensure that journal strategies are supported by effective policies, processes, services, and quality standards.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen journal positioning, audience engagement, portfolio visibility, and demand generation.

Leadership and Culture

  • Model the culture and behaviors PLOS is seeking to build, actively driving the culture change the organization needs through this transformation.
  • Serve as a collaborative leader across PLOS, fostering strong cross-functional partnerships and organizational alignment that enable shared organizational priorities to be delivered successfully.
  • Lead change effectively by ensuring a clear strategic rationale, defined outcomes, appropriate measures of success, realistic resource requirements and clear accountability and decision-making.

Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Business problem solver – operates with curiosity to get to the root of the business problem to ensure the ultimate solution is grounded in PLOS’s strategy and mission.
  • Substantial experience launching Open Access journals from proposal to publication.
  • Strong commercial and financial skills, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, business planning and P&L ownership.
  • Substantial experience in STM publishing with progressively increased responsibility.
  • Experience managing senior publishing professionals, or comparable portfolio leaders.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic plans that deliver measurable business and operational outcomes.
  • Strong track record of leading and developing high-performing, geographically distributed teams.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills across cultures, disciplines, and organizational functions.
  • Dedication to open access and transforming scholarly communication, with a genuine interest in engaging productively with the scientific community.

Preferred

  • Experience leading high-volume journal portfolios and/or megajournals.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some national and international travel may be required.
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones may be required.

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (US): $145,000- $157,000 or (UK) £90,000- £104,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.

BENEFITS:

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

UK:

  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Income protection 
  • Personal accident insurance
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out.

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

Visit to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World-leading enterprise organisations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon.

The Role

Outreach is redefining how revenue teams work, and product managers here sit at the center of that work. As a Senior Product Manager within the business unit for Forecasting, Deal Management & Analytics, you will own a product area end to end. This will include the vision, the strategy, the roadmap, and the outcomes for capabilities used every day by sellers and the leaders who run their teams. We are hiring for someone with high product competency and capability that can be adapted into multiple areas of the product. For example, one area we are actively investing in is helping revenue leaders understand and improve seller performance, turning Outreach’s data on real selling behavior into insight, guidance, and coaching that measurably lifts how teams perform.

This role sits within our growing product organization in India, working alongside engineering, design, and data science partners across India, Czechia, and the US.

You will own how AI shows up in your product area: which use cases are worth building, what quality bar those capabilities have to clear, and how you know they are clearing it. This includes evaluation design, guardrails, and playing a hands on role in ensuring AI outcomes.

You will have latitude to decide what gets built and why, with less process than a mature organization but more resources than a small startup. You will be measured on the impact those decisions have on customers and on the business.

Your Daily Adventures Will Include:

    • Owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your product area, and being accountable for the outcomes it delivers

    • Owning the AI application in your product area: identifying and prioritising the use cases worth building, and being willing to say when a problem is better solved without AI

    • Defining what “good” means for AI-powered capabilities — the evaluation criteria, quality bars, and offline and online measurement that tell you whether a model or agent is genuinely working for customers, and holding the roadmap to those bars

    • Partnering with data science and ML engineering to take capabilities from experimentation into production, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop design, and the failure modes customers will actually hit

    • Defining and prioritisingthe work — making explicit trade-offs on scope, sequencing, and timelines, and explaining the reasoning to partners and leadership

    • Capturing voice of the customer: leading discovery sessions, running research, and building a first-hand understanding of how revenue teams actually work

    • Establishing the metrics that define success for your area like adoption, quality, and business impact,and using them to steer the roadmap

    • Tracking the market, competitive landscape, and customer feedback, and translating them into positioning and roadmap priorities

    • Working with product marketing, enablement, and finance on launch, positioning, pricing, and packaging

    • Driving cross-organisational initiatives where your area depends on, or is depended on by, other product teams

Our Vision Of You:

    • 7+ years of product management experience building enterprise or B2B SaaS products

    • Experience launching AI or data products with LLM-powered capabilities, copilots, or agentic workflows, including ownership of their quality after launch

    • Fluency in modern AI stacks: model integration, context orchestration, prompt design, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks

    • A demonstrated ability to translate complex AI capabilities into simple product experiences and measurable customer value

    • Proven ability to work closely with engineering and data scientists to take models from experimentation to production

    • Comfortable building a business case, working directly with data to test a hypothesis, and making decisions under uncertainty

    • Customer empathy, and the discipline to keep talking to users rather than reasoning from assumptions

    • The ability to set a longer-term strategy for your area while driving meaningful short-term impact, and to bring senior leadership and cross-functional partners along with you

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience with analytics, reporting, or performance-measurement products, or with products that turn behavioural data into recommendations and guidance

    • Experience building products for go-to-market teams including sales, marketing, revenue operations, or customer success

    • Experience with conversation intelligence, or with products built on unstructured interaction data

    • A clear understanding of AI governance, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI principles as they apply to enterprise readiness

    • Experience working in a distributed product organisation across multiple regions

Blake Willson Group has a distinguished track record of exceptional performance, achieving operational efficiencies that allow our clients to do more with less. BWG has earned the confidence of its clients by consistently exceeding expectations through its unwavering commitment to best value solutions, implemented with speed.

Job Location:

This role is 100% remote.

Clearance:

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust Security Clearance.

Job Description:

Blake Willson Group is seeking an Acquisition Support Specialist to support federal procurements throughout the acquisition lifecycle, from acquisition planning through contract closeout. In this role, you will develop and review acquisition documentation, research federal acquisition requirements, monitor procurement milestones, and coordinate with contracting, program, finance, legal, and other stakeholders to support timely and compliant acquisition outcomes. In this position, you will:

  • Independently support federal procurements from acquisition planning through contract award, administration, and closeout.
  • Advise program offices on acquisition strategies, procurement documentation, timelines, risks, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and review Acquisition Plans, Market Research Reports, SOWs, PWSs, SOOs, IGCEs, Source Selection Plans, Determinations and Findings, and Justifications and Approvals.
  • Develop and review RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, and other solicitation documents while ensuring procurement packages and acquisition files are complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Research the FAR, agency supplements, and procurement policies and provide recommendations regarding acquisition and contract administration issues.
  • Support proposal and quotation evaluations, including technical, management, past performance, and price documentation, as well as negotiation documentation and award recommendations.
  • Support contract awards, task orders, modifications, funding actions, option exercises, and administrative changes while monitoring schedules and identifying risks to procurement milestones.
  • Coordinate with Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, CORs, program managers, financial personnel, legal counsel, and other stakeholders; prepare reports, briefings, trackers, and management communications; and provide guidance and quality reviews to junior acquisition staff.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Acquisition Management, Contract Management, or a related field.
  • 4 years of experience supporting federal acquisitions, preferably as a Federal Contract Specialist, Acquisition Specialist, Procurement Analyst, Contracting Officer support professional, or in a similar role.
