Desired Skills:

  • Prior experience as a Federal Contract Specialist, Contracting Officer, Procurement Analyst, Acquisition Specialist, or in a similar role.
  • Experience working within a federal procurement or contracting office.
  • FAC-C Professional, DAWIA Contracting, or equivalent acquisition certification or training.
  • Experience with GSA Schedules, GWACs, IDIQ contracts, BPAs, and task or delivery orders.
  • Experience supporting source selections, proposal evaluations, acquisition planning, price analysis, or contract administration.
  • Experience using federal acquisition systems such as PRISM, Momentum, ConWrite, Procurement Desktop-Defense, FPDS, SAM.gov, or similar systems.

At Blake Willson Group, we believe in transparency and fairness in compensation practices. For this position, we offer a competitive salary range of $70,000 to $100,000 in the United States. Your individual salary within this range will be determined by various factors, including but not limited to your education, experience, skills, and geographic location. We also provide a comprehensive Total Rewards package, which includes major medical benefits such as dental and vision coverage, a 401(k)-contribution plan, holiday and personal time off, professional development training & certification benefits, health & wellness subsidies, paid time off for community service, and more. We value your contributions and are committed to recognizing and rewarding your performance and the value you bring to our business.

raw.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

As a Microsoft 365 Copilot Solutions Architect, you’ll serve as a customer-facing technical advisor specializing in generative AI, workplace productivity, and agentic solutions. You’ll help enterprise customers identify valuable AI use cases, deploy secure and governed solutions, and progress from foundational functionality to advanced adoption that delivers measurable business value.

You’ll work across customers, implementation partners, account stakeholders, and technical delivery teams to accelerate deployment, resolve adoption barriers, and support organizational change. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with customer education, executive communication, and adoption strategy.

What You'll Do

  • Drive sustained adoption of enterprise AI assistants, collaboration tools, and AI agents through structured customer success and change-management plans.
  • Advise customers and partners on designing, deploying, customizing, and operationalizing AI-powered workplace solutions.
  • Help customers identify, prioritize, and implement AI and agentic use cases aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead technical engagements to resolve barriers related to identity, security, compliance, governance, data access, licensing, and platform readiness.
  • Establish secure and responsible AI foundations, including data protection, oversharing controls, information governance, and compliance practices.
  • Guide customers through AI agent development and governance using a register, govern, and protect framework.
  • Develop adoption and change-management plans addressing executive sponsorship, user segmentation, communications, training, and enablement.
  • Educate customers and partners through technical demonstrations, presentations, workshops, and end-user training.
  • Use adoption analytics and platform insights to communicate usage trends, business impact, progress, and return on investment.
  • Engage technical and business decision-makers, including executive stakeholders, to align AI adoption with measurable organizational outcomes.
  • Coordinate partner-led implementations and internal delivery resources to accelerate deployment, activation, and adoption at scale.
  • Manage committed adoption and consumption milestones across assigned customer accounts.
  • Analyze usage and business-outcome signals to identify expansion, renewal, and additional solution opportunities.
  • Capture customer feedback, technical blockers, adoption patterns, and success stories to support ongoing product and delivery improvements.
  • Lead and motivate technical communities while strengthening collaboration among customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or a related field, plus 7 to 9 years of relevant experience, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant experience in areas such as cloud or infrastructure technologies, IT consulting or support, systems administration, network operations, software development or support, solution architecture, practice development, or technical consulting.
  • At least 5 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing role.
  • At least 5 years of experience delivering customer-facing technical projects.
  • At least 5 years of experience working with enterprise productivity and cloud platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage internal and external stakeholders and communicate effectively with technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and driving adoption of enterprise AI productivity solutions, including administration, analytics, and organizational change management.
  • Deep expertise in identity, security, compliance, and information governance, including conditional access, identity governance, sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention, AI data security posture management, and advanced content management controls.
  • Experience building, deploying, and governing AI agents through a low-code agent development platform.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience installing, deploying, and customizing enterprise AI assistants and agentic solutions.
  • Experience with comparable generative AI platforms, such as Gemini or similar enterprise AI technologies.
  • Proven success helping customers progress from initial AI experimentation to sustained, advanced adoption.
  • Experience presenting AI capabilities and delivering customer education, technical enablement, workshops, or end-user training.
  • Strong presentation and executive-engagement skills, particularly with senior business and technology leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical adoption metrics with business value, productivity gains, and return on investment.
  • Experience developing adoption and change-management strategies for enterprise technology implementations.
  • Ability to combine strong business and customer-adoption skills with hands-on technical expertise.
  • Experience working through implementation partners and coordinating cross-functional delivery resources.
  • Ability to lead technical communities and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Comfort working with customers from different cultures in a fast-paced, digital-first environment.
  • Adaptability, intellectual curiosity, and enthusiasm for continuously learning emerging AI technologies.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $50.00 - $55.00 USD per hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Remote, United States

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

raw.description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.

At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!

This role is the primary representative of the interests of stakeholders, sponsors, and potential users in the organization. This role is responsible for ensuring that solution decisions align with the overall strategy and that Features and User Stories are properly vetted, prepared, executed, and delivered to customers. This role collaborates with others to ensure that proposed solutions meet demonstrated customer needs, are feasible to implement, and can be profitably delivered to customers. This role collaborates with the superiors to ensure that the strategic intent described in business epics is appropriately realized in Features and User Stories and makes decisions about when sufficient value has been generated to trim or defer lower value features and stories from the team’s backlog. This role maintains a ready backlog and collaborates with the leadership to establish the solution vision and roadmap. The Role communicates the strategic vision and outcomes to Delivery Teams while embodying the voice of the customer.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Ensure product decisions are aligned with the organization's strategy and communicate the strategic vision and outcomes to other teams
  • Assist the others in defining Epic success criteria and desired outcomes
  • Evaluate, prepare, execute, and deliver Epics, Features, and User Stories
  • Provide solution options considering a balance between capacity and demand
  • Contribute to a ready backlog of actionable work that will flow to cross functional Delivery Teams that effectively communicates Acceptance Criteria which aligns with content outlined in the Epic
  • Represent the voice of the customer, advocating for their needs and interests
  • Conduct user interviews to gain a deeper understanding of customer problems
  • Validate that work is prioritized according to strategic direction
  • Ensure alignment between the work delivered in each release and the strategic vision
  • Identify risk and impediments between backlog items and ensure they are effectively managed
  • Coordinate and participate in product releases and change management activities
  • Prepare, organize, and communicate release notes and to clients or internal users
  • Create and Monitor metrics to help improve the process and/or verify it is on track
  • Mentor, coach, and train team members as needed
  • Other activities as may be assigned by your manager

Qualifications/ Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Computer Science, or Engineering) or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum of 8+ years of industry and/or relevant experience, typically with 2+ years in an AVP level role or external equivalent. Minimum of five years of increasing responsibility for product or service development, including the ability to measure the value of solutions delivered to customers
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience relating to solution design and engagement with full stack development techniques with a heavy focus on End User usability and UX designs
  • Strong analytical skills to identify and propose persona/outcome combinations for business impact
  • Experienced data engineering skills with ties to development and management of logical data models with experience in big data
  • Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Proficient understanding of application infrastructure, system architecture, and operating system
  • Proven experience in stakeholder management, representing interests, and fostering collaboration Strategic mindset with the ability to align product decisions with organizational strategy
  • Proficiency in vetting, preparing, executing, and delivering Features and User Stories
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey the strategic vision and outcomes to various teams
  • Experience in conducting user interviews and generative or evaluative research to inform decision-making
  • Familiarity with backlog management, prioritization techniques, and ensuring alignment with strategic goals
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and their application in product or service development
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail in maintaining backlogs and managing dependencies
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Real estate experience preferred, but not required
  • A strong commitment to integrity, professionalism, and SitusAMC’s guiding principles
  • A demonstrable ability to collaborate effectively with team members in diverse groups and regions

Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. SitusAMC does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms or any third parties. Any unsolicited resume submitted to SitusAMC in any manner will be considered SitusAMC property, and SitusAMC will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

The annual full time base salary range for this role is

$110,000.00 - $170,000.00

Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, certain positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines, position eligibility and SitusAMC Senior Management approval. SitusAMC offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

raw.description:
Jesteś młodą, ambitną osobą, która właśnie ukończyła studia i szuka pierwszego kroku w karierze zawodowej? Nie mogłeś/mogłaś trafić lepiej! Obecnie poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Administracji w Polsce – doświadczenie zawodowe nie jest wymagane.

Celem tego stanowiska jest wsparcie procesów administracyjnych w rezerwacji audytów w krajach Europy Wschodniej. Do głównych obowiązków Specjalisty/-ki ds. Administracji należą:

  • Przyjmowanie zleceń usługowych i logowanie ich w wewnętrznym systemie.
  • Inicjowanie i przeprowadzenie korespondencji e-mailowej dotyczącej planowanej usługi.
  • Pozyskiwanie dokumentów od audytowanych firm.
  • Weryfikacja niezbędnych informacji (nazwa fabryki, adres, liczba pracowników itp.).
  • Aktualizacja wewnętrznych systemów.
  • Potwierdzanie terminu audytu z audytowanymi podmiotami.
  • Kontakt z klientami, jeśli jest to konieczne.
  • Wnioskowanie o wystawienie faktur i zbieranie potwierdzeń przedpłat.
  • Dotrzymywanie ustalonych terminów planowania i proaktywne monitorowanie postępów.
  • Przestrzeganie wytycznych rezerwacyjnych Eurofins lub specyficznych wymagań klienta.
  • Omawianie cotygodniowych aktualizacji podczas spotkań z zespołem.
  • Przypisywanie audytorów do poszczególnych zleceń.
  • Wysyłanie pakietów audytowych do audytorów w wymaganych terminach.
  • Udział w spotkaniach z lokalnymi klientami, jeśli zajdzie taka potrzeba.

Czego oczekujemy:

  • Język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną pracę (dodatkowy język będzie dużym atutem).
  • Znajomość programów MS Office.
  • Wysoka motywacja, profesjonalizm i entuzjazm.
  • Umiejętność pracy pod presją czasu.
  • Bardzo dobra dbałość o szczegóły.
  • Umiejętność pracy wielozadaniowej, ustalania priorytetów, organizowania i koordynowania własnej pracy.
  • Zdolność rozumienia potrzeb klientów oraz proponowania i komunikowania najbardziej odpowiednich rozwiązań.
  • Umiejętność wpływania na innych w celu osiągania wspólnych celów z korzyścią dla klientów.
  • Pewność siebie oraz silne umiejętności interpersonalne i komunikacyjne.
  • Doskonałe umiejętności komunikacji pisemnej i werbalnej.
  • Umiejętność budowania dobrych relacji roboczych ze współpracownikami, audytorami i klientami.

Korzyści z pracy w zespole Eurofins:

  • Możliwości rozwoju zawodowego w różnych kierunkach – jesteśmy stosunkowo młodą firmą w Polsce.
  • Międzynarodowe środowisko pracy – codzienny kontakt z zespołami globalnymi.
  • Praca w 100% zdalna.
  • Elastyczna forma czasu pracy.
  • Prywatna opieka medyczna, Multisport.

Eurofins Scientific to międzynarodowa firma, która oferuje wszechstronną gamę badań analitycznych klientom różnych sektorów. Grupa Eurofins jest światowym liderem w badaniach żywności, środowiska, produktów farmaceutycznych, kosmetyków oraz testów agrochemicznych (CRO). raw.excerpt: US Salary: $175,000 - $215,000 About UsBonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact.
raw.description:
US Salary: $175,000 - $215,000

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist to build Bonterra's first dedicated pricing function. This is a senior individual-contributor role (no direct reports at launch), and you'll own the discipline end to end: willingness-to-pay research, value metric design, packaging architecture, and AI pricing methodologies across a SaaS product portfolio and a fast-growing AI product line.

You won't simply be inheriting a pre-built function to maintain or administrate. You're coming in to assess what's already there, decide what to keep and what to rebuild, then stand up the strategy and cadence from the ground up. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Bonterra to get a baseline of current SaaS product and AI financial metrics, assess the Pricing Committee and governance structure, and align our pricing strategy to the annual operating plan goals for 2027 and beyond.

You'll be the first hire into a new pricing function, reporting directly to the CPO, who has direct experience with pricing strategy from PwC, startups, and PE software companies. You won't be evangelizing pricing discipline into a skeptical org, and you won't be handed a playbook to simply execute either. You're stepping into an executive room that's already bought into the importance of this work, and you'll have full latitude to shape what comes next. You own the strategy, the governance model, and the cadence going forward, not just the execution of decisions someone else already made. You will have investments in the proper tools to succeed.

In this role, you will:

  • Own willingness-to-pay research and value metric design for Bonterra Que (our AI-powered product suite that turns a customer's own fragmented data into actionable insights and recommendations, and a fast-growing part of our business) and for the broader product portfolio (Case Management, Fundraising Solutions, Fundraising Experiences, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Payments).

  • Build the pricing research methodology at Bonterra: conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp, and value-based pricing frameworks applied to a real, in-flight portfolio, not a greenfield exercise. We will then turn the findings into actionable decisions for our products.

  • Design packaging architecture including tier definitions, feature gating, bundle logic for current products as well as new Que AI skills coming to market.

  • Build and maintain competitive pricing intelligence against key competitors in the market, while also pulling from new approaches to AI pricing from high growth AI companies out of market.

  • Deliver the first annual pricing benchmark study for Bonterra, based on internal performance against a SaaS peer set, built to be board-ready.

  • Provide a pricing input on every new product investment proposal before it's approved, making revenue forecast projections a scored dimension within our business case structure.

  • Partner directly with the CPO on Pricing Committee strategic reviews and represent pricing methodology at a senior level across Product, Finance, and Commercial.

Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Research

  • Own willingness-to-pay studies for new SKUs, packaging changes, and Que monetization, starting with the Que willingness-to-pay study targeted for this year.

  • Define value metrics by category (per donor, per giving volume, per record, per insight): the foundation that drives durable net revenue retention, not just initial price point.

  • Own packaging architecture: tier definitions, feature gating, and bundle design across the portfolio.

  • Build and maintain the competitive pricing intelligence function.

AI & Que Monetization

  • Lead the monetization architecture for Bonterra Que, the highest-leverage pricing question in the portfolio: standardize attach motion, value metric, and bundle math across related product portfolios.

  • Partner with Product leaders to ensure pricing keeps pace with capabilities, as this is a fast-evolving product, and the pricing model has to move with it, not lag behind it.

  • You'll own the analysis, strategy, and transition plan from current pricing structures to usage-based and outcome-based pricing for Que. You will be the primary change agent for taking us from a set of traditional SaaS pricing models to AI-first monetization.

Cross-Functional Influence

  • Deliver pricing input to every new product investment proposal before it's approved: willingness-to-pay becomes a scored dimension in the review, not a footnote.

  • Partner with the CPO to run Pricing Committee strategic reviews (quarterly tactical, annual strategic).

  • Partner with the Finance organization on operating-plan-aligned pricing performance inputs. Align to EBITDA and margin goals set with our executive team.

  • Partner with the Commercial organization on competitive pricing intelligence feeding deal desk and discount governance.

  • Coordinate with the active SKU and Pricing Operations workstream to ensure new pricing architecture lands cleanly in the operational system of record.

Qualifications

You are:

  • A pricing methodologist, not a spreadsheet operator. You've run conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp, and value-based pricing studies and can defend the methodology to a CFO and a customer in the same week.

  • Comfortable formalizing something distributed, not building from a blank page. The basics already exist today: a discount framework, embedded pricing partners across the business, a Pricing Committee charter. What's missing is the rigor, the methodology, and the scale. You'll design the first formal value metric framework and competitive intelligence process, building on what's already there rather than starting from zero.

  • Fluent in where AI pricing is actually headed, not just the traditional SaaS playbook of the last decade. You know the difference between usage-based and outcome-based, when each earns its keep, and how to move a portfolio from one to the other without breaking trust. Que monetization is the single highest-leverage question you'll own.

  • A strong cross-functional operator. You will actively work with our CPO, CFO, CRO, and CEO on the pricing strategy and execution, adjusting the framing for each without changing the substance.

  • Comfortable operating without a team at launch. As an individual contributor, you'll build the methodology first; the org grows around what you prove out.

Reqiurements:

  • 6+ years in pricing strategy, either in-house at a multi-product B2B SaaS company or in a pricing strategy consulting practice (Simon-Kucher, McKinsey Pricing, BCG, OpenView, etc).

  • Demonstrated ownership of a willingness-to-pay study from design through pricing decision, not just participation in one.

  • Experience designing value metrics and packaging for a multi-product or multi-segment portfolio.

  • Exposure to usage-based and outcome-based AI pricing models, and a point of view on when to graduate from one to the other: this is a strong plus given Que's trajectory.

  • Comfort operating in a PE-backed environment where pricing discipline is a named valuation lever.

You've successfully:

  • Led a willingness-to-pay or value-based pricing study that changed a real pricing decision, not just informed a deck.

  • Built a competitive pricing intelligence process from scratch and kept it current enough to be trusted.

  • Partnered with Product and Engineering leadership to translate pricing strategy into packaging and feature-gating decisions that shipped.

  • Operated as an individual contributor with senior-level influence, shaping executive decisions without a team behind you.

If you're a pricing leader who wants to build the methodological foundation for how a mission-driven AI-native SaaS company monetizes, and who believes pricing is a product discipline, not a finance afterthought, we want to meet you.

At Bonterra, we’re building AI-powered tools to solve real human challenges—and we want teammates who share that enthusiasm. We value people who will champion AI and bring diverse perspectives from different industries, backgrounds, and cultures. Together, we create AI that breaks down barriers, empowers communities, and delivers better outcomes

At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.

Our Culture

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. At Bonterra, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being and growth - explore full details here.

Compensation and benefits for this role apply to full-time employees in the United States and may vary based on local standards, laws and norms. Pay is determined by location, skills, experience, and education, and is one part of Bonterra’s total rewards package, which may also include bonuses, incentives, equity, and a comprehensive benefits program.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

At Bonterra, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please submit a request.

raw.description:
About Forma.ai:

Forma.ai is a Series B startup that's revolutionizing how sales compensation is designed, managed and optimized. We handle billions in annual managed commissions for market leaders like Edmentum, Stryker, and Autodesk.

Our growth has been fuelled by our passion for fundamentally changing and shaping how companies use sales intelligence to drive business strategy.

We’re welcoming equally driven individuals who are excited about creating something big!

About the team:

The Customer Operations team is at the heart of Forma.ai's mission. This team has a direct impact on the growth of Forma.ai. They are results-driven and solutions-minded.

The Customer Operations team works closely with our customers, helping them to understand and take advantage of all the features Forma.ai offers and ensuring that they get the most value from the platform.

What you'll be doing:

Reporting & Dashboarding

  • Design, maintain, and enhance dashboards in BI tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Salesforce/HubSpot reports) to monitor marketing campaign performance, sales pipeline health, lead flow, and conversion metrics
  • Automate recurring reports and implement self-serve analytics capabilities for GTM teams

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analyze funnel performance from top-of-funnel marketing campaigns to bottom-of-funnel sales outcomes
  • Provide regular insights intokey KPIs like campaign ROI, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and attribution across channels
  • Support A/B testing initiatives, sales activity analysis, and segmentation strategies

Scripting & Automation

  • Write Python and SQL scriptsto extract, clean, and structure data from external sources (e.g., job boards, press releases, M&A feeds, web scraping APIs)
  • Build automated enrichment pipelines to augment CRM and marketing data with third-party insights (e.g., firmographics, hiring activity, technology stack, funding events)

Data Quality & Tooling

  • Take ownership of data cleanliness and integrity across GTM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Databricks), including investigating issues, proposing solutions, and manually resolving historical data problems when necessary
  • Maintain and improve key GTM logic — including lead scoring models, lifecycle stage transitions, attribution frameworks, and related automation rules — ensuring they are well-defined, consistent, and actionable

What we're looking for:

  • Background in Engineering, Commerce, Mathematics and/or Statistics
  • Natural curiosity about AI and emerging technologies — especially where they intersect with automation, data, and workflow orchestration across the GTM stack
  • Familiarity with B2B go-to-market motions and how to measure their effectiveness
  • Experience in report building, data analysis and workflow automationwithin a GTM tech stack (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, BI tools)
  • Proficiency in SQL or Python and familiarity with at least one BI tool (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau)
  • 3-5 years of related experience
  • High achiever with a strong sense of ownership
  • Ability to take ownership and run tasks in a fast-paced and evolving environment

What you can expect from us

Meaningful compensation. In addition to your base salary, you’ll join our employee stock ownership plan to further recognize your contributions to Forma.ai’s success.

Healthcare coverage. We have a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and a paid parental leave program.

Learning and development. Access the resources you want to help you grow in your role by utilizing our $750 yearly training stipend.

Growth. You’ll have a huge opportunity to build a career for yourself and gain the type of experience you’re looking for, whether that’s as an individual contributor or as a people leader.

Our Values:

  • Work well, together. We’re real. We have kids and pets. Mortgages and student loans. We’re in this together, so no matter how brilliant any one of us is, we always play nice with one another – no exceptions.
  • Be precise. Be relentless. We believe complacency breeds failure, so we set new goals as quickly as we achieve them. We persist in the face of adversity, learn from our mistakes, and push each other to continuously improve. The status-quo is kryptonite.
  • Love our tech. Love our customers. Our platform solves a very complex problem in a currently underserved market. While everyone at Forma isn’t customer-facing, we’re all customer-focused. Maybe even slightly customer-obsessed. ­


Use of AI for Recruitment

Currently, Forma.ai does not use artificial intelligence as part of our recruitment process, specifically but not limited to the screening, filtering and shortlisting of applicants.

Our commitment to you:

Forma is a proud equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.Every effort to accommodate candidates for accessibility will be made upon request. Information received related to accommodations will be addressed confidentially. We know that applying to a new role takes a lot of effort. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. There are many paths to a successful career and we’re looking forward to reading yours.

We thank all candidates for their interest however only qualified applicants will be shortlisted.

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

As a Cortex Transformation Engineer, you are a critical part of the Global Transformation Practice, ensuring our enterprise customers undergo a flawless migration and security operations transformation to modern platforms.
Operating within a synchronized global model, you will own the end-to-end customer transition lifecycle, compressed into a high-velocity sprint. You will combine deep technical engineering acumen with exceptional customer-facing delivery to execute data cutovers, lead immersive operational workshops, and demonstrate quantifiable business value to customer security leadership.

Your Impact

  • Technical Migration & Integration: Execute the technical migration of customer environments from legacy to modern platforms. Own policy mappings, data retention configurations, API setups, and log ingestion validations against Palo Alto Networks "Golden Standard" design templates.

  • Operationalization & DITL Delivery: Bridge the gap between implementation and true platform adoption by running practitioner-focused "Day in the Life" (DITL) workshops. Educate customer teams on native platform workflows, alert triage, incident response, Agentic-AI and automated playbooks using both 1-on-1 and cohort-based delivery models.

  • Value Realization Executive Cadence: Lead highly structured Value Realization sessions with customer technical stakeholders. Leverage native platform dashboards to mathematically demonstrate ROI, security efficacy and operational efficiency to secure formal project sign-off and customer delight.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Professional-level technical acumen with security operations infrastructure, cloud migrations, or technical consulting.

  • Hands-on expertise with the Palo Alto Networks portfolio (Cortex XDR/XSIAM, Prisma Cloud, or Strata) or direct competitive migration experience.

  • Strong technical background in security automation, including execution of CLI scripting, Python, and REST APIs for bulk policy configuration and data modeling.

  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills with a proven ability to run technical workshops and maintain strong executive presence.

  • A "scale mindset" with a focus on using artificial intelligence and automation, developing reusable playbook concepts, and authoring technical documentation.

  • French Speaking Preferred

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$204,800.00 - $281,600.00/yr

Job Description

The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Individualized Therapy Operations, the Associate Director, Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) Lead is responsible for leading the centralized operational coordination capability that supports execution of the Intismeran treatment journey.

This leader will build, develop, and oversee a team of Treatment Site Operations Coordinators (TSOCs) responsible for coordinating patient cases, managing operational workflows, facilitating communication across stakeholders, and ensuring timely progression of patients through key treatment journey milestones. The role serves as the primary operational bridge between Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, patient support programs, and internal teams.

The TSOC team functions as the centralized coordination hub for the treatment journey, providing operational visibility, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and case-level support to ensure patients successfully progress through each stage of the individualized therapy process. This role is accountable for establishing consistent operational standards, escalation pathways, and ways of working that enable seamless coordination across the treatment ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Build, lead, and develop the Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) organization, establishing team structure, performance expectations, ways of working, and capabilities required to support launch readiness and future scale.

  • Lead centralized operational coordination across the treatment journey, ensuring effective communication and alignment among treatment sites, Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, alliance stakeholders, and internal teams.

  • Oversee the centralized case management capability, including active patient case coordination, operational escalations, cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring timely communication and resolution of issues that may impact treatment completion.

  • Establish and manage operational escalation processes, proactively identifying, triaging, escalating, and resolving operational issues that may impact customer experience, treatment completion, or therapy delivery timelines.

  • Drive visibility and transparency across the treatment ecosystem, providing timely status updates, operational communications, and stakeholder coordination throughout the treatment journey.

  • Partner with the Individualized Therapy Operations team, Treatment Site Strategy team, TSL leadership, Patient Support, and IT to identify and resolve operational barriers, improve stakeholder experiences, and drive continuous improvement across the treatment journey.

  • Establish and monitor operational service standards, performance expectations, and response timelines for the TSOC organization to ensure consistent execution and a high-quality treatment site experience.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, treatment site experience, execution consistency, and treatment completion, incorporating customer feedback and operational insights to improve future performance.

Education:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (BA/BS)

MBA or equivalent preferred

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry, including experience supporting treatment operations, patient operations, customer operations, treatment site operations, commercial operations, or other cross-functional operational functions.

  • Experience leading customer-facing operations, patient services, hub services, or customer support organizations, with a strong understanding of customer experience and operational issue resolution.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating activities across multiple internal teams and external stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to manage operational escalations, resolve complex issues, and drive alignment across different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong operational execution, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience establishing operational processes, workflows, service standards, and performance expectations that support consistent execution and customer experience.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively communicate across field teams, treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, vendors, and leadership teams.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and operational excellence.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting the commercialization of complex therapies, including, cell therapy, gene therapy, radioligand therapy, or other highly coordinated treatment models.

  • Experience working directly with treatment sites, hospitals, academic medical centers, community oncology practices, or integrated delivery networks.

  • Experience with treatment journey orchestration platforms, workflow technologies, customer support systems, case management platforms, or operational control towers.

Required Skills:

Communication Management, Customer Engagement, Customer Feedback, Customer Management, Market Development, Patient Services, People Leadership, Product Launch Support, Product Management, Work Management

Talent Acquisition Specialist

At INTEGRITYOne Partners (IOP), we are a federal technology company focused on DevSecOps and agile software development, analytics and AI, cloud engineering, and data management. Our people are known for being technical Swiss army knives that are depended on by our clients to support a myriad of highly complex, technical problems within rapidly changing missions. We enable federal law enforcement clients to execute high-tempo, mission-critical work that ultimately improves the lives of the people they serve. Our culture is entrepreneurial, mission-first, and meritocratic, giving you direct access to decision-makers and real influence over how we win and deliver.


Job Description
INTEGRITYOne Partners is seeking a motivated, resourceful, and self-starting Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for full-cycle recruiting activities supporting current program needs, strategic growth initiatives, and proposal efforts within the federal government contracting space. This person will report directly to the Manager of People Operations.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships with technical professionals, and can effectively partner with hiring managers to attract and hire top talent. This individual will play a key role in supporting IOP's continued growth by identifying exceptional candidates, delivering a positive candidate experience, and helping build high-performing teams that support mission-critical government programs.

Location This position is remote; however, candidates located in Maryland, Washington, D.C., or Virginia are preferred.

Key Responsibilities:
Full-Cycle Technical Recruitment
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical and professional positions, from requisition intake through offer acceptance and pre-onboarding.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring priorities, technical requirements, and workforce planning needs.
  • Conduct candidate screenings, interviews, and assessments to evaluate qualifications, experience, and overall fit.
  • Coordinate and facilitate interviews while ensuring efficient and positive candidate experience.
Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development
  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to identify qualified candidates.
  • Build and maintain pipelines of cleared technical talent for current and future hiring needs.
  • Proactively engage passive candidates and cultivate long-term relationships within targeted talent communities.
  • Leverage LinkedIn, JazzHR, professional networks, employee referrals, and other creative sourcing channels to identify qualified cleared talent.
Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, recruiting activity, and hiring metrics within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Support the development and refinement of the recruiting processes, workflows, and documentation to drive efficiency and consistency.
  • Draft and update job descriptions that align with position requirements and federal contract needs.
  • Monitor recruiting metrics and provide insights on sourcing effectiveness, hiring trends, and process improvements to leadership team.
Business Growth Support
  • Partner with leadership to support proposal recruitment efforts and identify contingent candidates for upcoming opportunities.
  • Assist with workforce planning activities for new programs, contract transitions, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify, engage, and maintain relationships with contingent candidates to support proposal submissions, anticipated contract awards, and future staffing needs.
  • Stay informed on market trends, compensation considerations, security clearance requirements, and emerging recruiting best practices within the federal contracting industry.
People Operations Support
  • Provide support to the People Operations team with onboarding, employee communications, and other people-related initiatives as needed.
  • Assist with onboarding and new hire administrative processes, including coordination of required documentation and pre-employment activities.
  • Support the coordination of People Operations projects, programs, and administrative activities as needed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4-6 years of technical recruiting in the federal government contracting space.
  • Experience recruiting technical roles such as DevSecOps, software development, cloud, data analytics, digital modernization, engineering, and IT operations.
  • Familiarity with talent-acquisition best practices in a high-growth environment.
  • Knowledge of federal government contracting and security clearance processes preferred.
  • Knowledge of recruiting and employment requirements within the federal government contracting environment.
  • Experience managing ATS platforms (preferably JazzHR), sourcing tools, and recruiting technologies to manage candidate pipelines and hiring activity.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisitions while meeting hiring timelines.
Salary range: $75,000-$85,000

At INTEGRITYOne Partners, we hold ourselves and our team members to high standards—and when our people meet those standards, the personal and professional rewards are meaningful. We are committed to helping our employees grow their careers by providing opportunities to build valuable Federal knowledge and experience, develop in-demand skills, strengthen their professional capabilities, and access targeted education and training.

It is our policy to provide equal opportunity to each individual without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, family responsibility, pregnancy, political affiliation or any other status protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, benefits, promotion or termination. These decisions will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities.

360Learning is looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our DACH team. Your role will consist of generating opportunities from 360Learning top priority, highest potential accounts. As the owner of these accounts, you will be in charge of creating business opportunities for DACH Account Executives through inbound and outbound leads qualification. You will leverage bleeding-edge Sales Development Techniques & tools to engage prospects.
This position will play a key role in building a strong sales pipeline. More specifically, you will be in charge of your territory to qualify inbound and outbound leads and pitch our product to interested prospects. Throughout your conversations, you will detect customer pain points, understand their context, and how we can help. You will evangelize collaborative learning in the market, and present the 360Learning value proposition.
Working in close collaboration with your coach, marketing operations, demand gen, and sales, you will benefit from thorough onboarding and continuous learning & coaching opportunities as you grow.

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Finish onboarding and begin your core role as a BDR
  • Master the pitch and qualification methodology
  • Start qualifying leads and create your first opportunities for the AEs

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Fully master our tool stack and ramp up
  • Act as a partner to the Account Executives
  • Qualify your first SQL opportunities
  • Master how to prioritize your inbound and outbound leads pipeline and forecast your performance
  • Polish your qualification method to an advanced level
  • Master our tool stack SalesLoft, LinkedIn’s Sales Navigator, Gong, etc.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Be fully ramped on inbound and outbound methodologies
  • Achieve and exceed monthly quotas Sales Qualified Leads
  • Partner with Marketing to improve lead quality and get creative by bringing innovative lead generation ideas to weekly meetings
  • Research trends and best practices for creating interest and engagement

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Contribute as a subject-matter expert on the 360Learning platform and share your knowledge with the rest of the organization
  • Be involved in the onboarding of new members of the team

The Skills Set:

  • First experience in a B2B SaaS environment, as a BDR, SDR or Inside Sales
  • Previous experience in inbound lead generation and/or outbound
  • Preferred but not mandatory: experience using Salesforce, Salesloft, and Gong
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Active listening skills, ability to uncover customer needs and adaptability (fast-paced environment)
  • Fluent German and fluent English (B2 level or equivalent) proficiency
  • Enthusiasm for our culture explained here:

What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home perks, 1 month parental leave for the second parent
  • Balance: Flexible hours, remote work possible anywhere in Germany, France or the UK 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. raw.description:
At MissionWired, we help our partners create revolutionary fundraising strategies that advance their mission, change our country, and have a positive impact on the world.
We help our partners tell big, ambitious stories that invite their supporters into communities to raise mission-changing revenue. Our results are unrivaled, having converted more than $4.5 billion in donations to the world’s most trusted philanthropies and groundbreaking campaigns. We do it over email and SMS, in the mail, across social media, everywhere. We don’t think in terms of channels; we’re single-minded in pursuit of your success.
We’re innovative, progress-obsessed, do-gooders who care deeply about social change and continuing to push the limits on what we can accomplish together. We’ve brought strategies to life for nonprofit organizations working around the world, including Human Rights Watch, The Humane Society of the U.S., Save the Children, and Friends of the Earth. Over the years, we have worked with various progressive political organizations and believe that each election cycle is an opportunity for us to support organizations across the country and elect Democrats to legislative bodies up and down the ballot.
We’re an equal-opportunity employer and take seriously our commitment to equality and equity. Our efforts to be inclusive and create opportunity don’t end when someone joins us – they begin. We’ve set our sights on changing the world through our work and with our clients, and representation is at the foundation of what we do. We know that diversity of thought and background makes us stronger. That’s why we’re committed to building and maintaining a diverse community.
Every new team member broadens our perspective and allows us to think bigger. We’ll be at our best when people from underrepresented communities and people with a range of perspectives and lived experiences want to come, stay, and push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Overview:MissionWired is always seeking great people to join our teams. In our Resume Pools, you can submit your resume and we'll reach out as soon as we have an opening in your specialized field! Please note: we may not be actively hiring for this team, however, when we are, you may be the first to hear from us!
Does the idea for transforming millions of data points into unparalleled opportunities – supporting everything from electing Democrats to combating climate change throughout the world, sound exciting to you? Then you're in the right place! On our data and product teams, you'll be driving positive change alongside a team of data scientists and engineers developing first-of-their-kind machine-learning products. With us, you’ll put your skills to use for disruptive innovation that powers social good.
You’ll join a product team that is deeply devoted to inclusion, particularly in the following three areas:
Process: We create a context in which everyone is empowered to contribute.
Data-Driven: We are committed to using the power of data to support important causes.
Philanthropy: We empower diverse groups of individuals to participate in giving.
We want your ideas and your leadership. Join us. Let’s go!

Teams available for this resume pool:

  • Engineering (Data, Software, ML)
  • Data Science
  • Data Analysis
  • Product Management
  • Project Management
  • Full-Stack Web Development
  • This may not be a holistic list and is subject to change as new positions are added to the data and product teams.

Successful candidates will be responsible for (varying levels of responsibility depending on your experience):

  • Joining each and every one of your colleagues in creating an inclusive workspace;
  • Using an array of technological languages, models, and tools;
  • Working toward constantly improving data reliability and quality;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support their data related needs.

Must-have qualifications:

  • Attention to detail;
  • Intellectual curiosity to innovate on ways to solve data management issues;
  • Passion, energy, and excitement for progressive and philanthropic causes and all things digital.

Nice-to-have qualifications (depending on the role):

  • Python, Pandas, PySpark, SQL, R;
  • Familiarity with big data tools using AWS or other cloud services;
  • A passion for statistical methodology;
  • Experience with MLOps platforms like MLFlow, Sagemaker, and/or Google Cloud AI;
  • Experience in coding and/or analytics;
  • Experience in building data- and/or machine learning-based products;
  • A background in related industry sectors.
If hired on a full-time salaried basis then this position may be included in a union-represented collective bargaining unit, and specific employment terms and conditions are subject to collective bargaining.
Location
We are currently working remotely with no return to office date. Applicants may reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MD, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WA. Due to FL legislation, MissionWired is required to participate in e-verify.

Benefits

100% employer-paid premiums for platinum-level medical plan on a national health care network
100% employer-paid life insurance and short term disability
50% employer-paid vision and dental insurance
401(k) with 3% employer contribution
20 vacation days in addition to 12 paid holidays, sick days, bereavement leave, and a volunteer day off.
Paid parental leave at 100% of your salary
Financial support for reproductive and transgender care
Flexible telecommute and remote work policies
Company issued Mac products for home offices
Cell phone service reimbursement, meal and ride-share reimbursement, and other perks available
*Supporting your team on some nights and weekends as we approach high-volume times such as elections may be required.
If you feel you can do the job and are excited about this opportunity but are not sure if you meet all the qualifications, consider applying anyway. We’d love to hear from you!

Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We have an opportunity for a motivated individual to fill the role of Project Administrator. In this position, the successful candidate will support the HVAC Field Operations Team, which includes the Special Projects Team, UHP Team, Quality Assurance Team, and Project Managers, by helping keep projects organized, schedules coordinated, and communication flowing between stakeholders. Responsibilities may include monitoring procurement, fulfillment, and shipping activities; assisting with schedule management; coordinating communication between teams, contractors, and customers; creating and verifying work order data; creating tickets for installation support; tracking and updating project status; closing out work orders; and helping resolve customer or project-related issues as they arise.

Why This Role Is Important:
The Project Administrator plays a key support role in helping the HVAC Field Operations Team and other internal teams stay aligned throughout the project lifecycle. This role helps ensure administrative tasks, schedules, documentation, coordination, and follow-ups are completed accurately and efficiently, allowing internal teams to remain focused on successful project execution and customer outcomes.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Assist with the creation and assignment of project work orders (WOs) for contractors and internal teams.
  • Update and upload data provided by contractors or internal teams into internal project tracking systems.
  • Support the HVAC Field Operations Team, internal teams, and contractors with administrative tasks, including requesting customer as-builts, permits, equipment manuals, and other required project documentation.
  • Maintain forecasting and reporting spreadsheets.
  • Coordinate project schedules, coordinating meetings, documenting discussion points, and distributing minutes or follow-up items for project- and schedule-related meetings.
  • Support communication between the HVAC Field Operations Team, contractors, customers, and other internal stakeholders to help ensure project priorities, schedule changes, and outstanding action items are clearly communicated.
  • Manage internal team SharePoint folders and update documentation as needed.
  • Collaborate with Fulfillment to track equipment orders and assist with material warranty claims and equipment RMAs.
  • Support Accounts Payable (AP) with determining appropriate invoice routing.
  • Coordinate project closeout and activities with the HVAC Field Operations Team and other internal teams
  • Review internal tools, including Injobs and FSG, to ensure necessary project data and documentation are accurately updated before WO closeout.
  • Partner with the Service department to deploy and track installation-related warranty issues.
  • Coordinate contractor dispatcher for Go Back or Warranty service requests, track and oversee issue resolution, and update internal systems to reflect status and completion.
  • Support the Leadership Team with documenting and communicating workflow changes and updates to the HVAC project team.
  • Collaborate with the HVAC Field Operations Team, internal teams, and the Leadership Team with additional project-related responsibilities as needed.
  • Support customer satisfaction by documenting, reporting, and helping facilitate resolution of project-related issues.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required.
  • 2+ years of proven work experience as a Project Coordinator, Project Administrator, or similar role.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to multitask and manage time effectively.
  • Strong client-facing, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Proficiency with computers and business software for a variety of administrative and project-related tasks.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications, including Word and Excel.

Location: Remote

Compensation
$28.85—$33.65 USD

Compensation is based on factors including level of experience, skillset, qualifications, and location.

What We Offer:

  • Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing, supportive company environment
  • Competitive pay
  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, vison, 401K, life insurance, and disability insurance
  • Opportunity to work as part of a team that values its members and works together to achieve positive change.

raw.description:
At MissionWired, we help our partners create revolutionary fundraising strategies that advance their mission, change our country, and have a positive impact on the world.
We help our partners tell big, ambitious stories that invite their supporters into communities to raise mission-changing revenue. Our results are unrivaled, having converted more than $4.5 billion in donations to the world’s most trusted philanthropies and groundbreaking campaigns. We do it over email and SMS, in the mail, across social media, everywhere. We don’t think in terms of channels; we’re single-minded in pursuit of your success.
We’re innovative, progress-obsessed, do-gooders who care deeply about social change and continuing to push the limits on what we can accomplish together. We’ve brought strategies to life for nonprofit organizations working around the world, including Human Rights Watch, The Humane Society of the U.S., Save the Children, and Friends of the Earth. Over the years, we have worked with various progressive political organizations and believe that each election cycle is an opportunity for us to support organizations across the country and elect Democrats to legislative bodies up and down the ballot.
We’re an equal-opportunity employer and take seriously our commitment to equality and equity. Our efforts to be inclusive and create opportunity don’t end when someone joins us – they begin. We’ve set our sights on changing the world through our work and with our clients, and representation is at the foundation of what we do. We know that diversity of thought and background makes us stronger. That’s why we’re committed to building and maintaining a diverse community.
Every new team member broadens our perspective and allows us to think bigger. We’ll be at our best when people from underrepresented communities and people with a range of perspectives and lived experiences want to come, stay, and push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Overview:MissionWired is always seeking great people to join our teams. In our Resume Pools, you can submit your resume and we'll reach out as soon as we have an opening in your specialized field! Please note: we may not be actively hiring for this team, however, when we are, you may be the first to hear from us!
Does the idea for transforming millions of data points into unparalleled opportunities – supporting everything from electing Democrats to combating climate change throughout the world, sound exciting to you? Then you're in the right place! On our data and product teams, you'll be driving positive change alongside a team of data scientists and engineers developing first-of-their-kind machine-learning products. With us, you’ll put your skills to use for disruptive innovation that powers social good.
You’ll join a product team that is deeply devoted to inclusion, particularly in the following three areas:
Process: We create a context in which everyone is empowered to contribute.
Data-Driven: We are committed to using the power of data to support important causes.
Philanthropy: We empower diverse groups of individuals to participate in giving.
We want your ideas and your leadership. Join us. Let’s go!

Teams available for this resume pool:

  • Engineering (Data, Software, ML)
  • Data Science
  • Data Analysis
  • Product Management
  • Project Management
  • Full-Stack Web Development
  • This may not be a holistic list and is subject to change as new positions are added to the data and product teams.

Successful candidates will be responsible for (varying levels of responsibility depending on your experience):

  • Joining each and every one of your colleagues in creating an inclusive workspace;
  • Using an array of technological languages, models, and tools;
  • Working toward constantly improving data reliability and quality;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support their data related needs.

Must-have qualifications:

  • Attention to detail;
  • Intellectual curiosity to innovate on ways to solve data management issues;
  • Passion, energy, and excitement for progressive and philanthropic causes and all things digital.

Nice-to-have qualifications (depending on the role):

  • Python, Pandas, PySpark, SQL, R;
  • Familiarity with big data tools using AWS or other cloud services;
  • A passion for statistical methodology;
  • Experience with MLOps platforms like MLFlow, Sagemaker, and/or Google Cloud AI;
  • Experience in coding and/or analytics;
  • Experience in building data- and/or machine learning-based products;
  • A background in related industry sectors.
If hired on a full-time salaried basis then this position may be included in a union-represented collective bargaining unit, and specific employment terms and conditions are subject to collective bargaining.
Location
We are currently working remotely with no return to office date. Applicants may reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MD, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WA. Due to FL legislation, MissionWired is required to participate in e-verify.

Benefits

100% employer-paid premiums for platinum-level medical plan on a national health care network
100% employer-paid life insurance and short term disability
50% employer-paid vision and dental insurance
401(k) with 3% employer contribution
20 vacation days in addition to 12 paid holidays, sick days, bereavement leave, and a volunteer day off.
Paid parental leave at 100% of your salary
Financial support for reproductive and transgender care
Flexible telecommute and remote work policies
Company issued Mac products for home offices
Cell phone service reimbursement, meal and ride-share reimbursement, and other perks available
*Supporting your team on some nights and weekends as we approach high-volume times such as elections may be required.
If you feel you can do the job and are excited about this opportunity but are not sure if you meet all the qualifications, consider applying anyway. We’d love to hear from you!

raw.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Program Manager to support business operations, strategic initiatives, and program governance within a fast-paced technology environment. In this role, you will own recurring business rhythms, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, maintain critical team resources and knowledge repositories, and help ensure programs operate efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with senior stakeholders, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of projects with minimal oversight. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to improve operational processes, support strategic initiatives, and lead projects from planning through execution.

Responsibilities

  • Manage recurring business rhythms, leadership meetings, and operational cadences, including agendas, materials, action items, and follow-up.
  • Provide program administration and coordination for strategic initiatives across multiple workstreams.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, risk and issue logs, and other program governance materials.
  • Track project dependencies, deliverables, decisions, and action items to ensure accountability and timely execution.
  • Build, maintain, and organize team SharePoint sites and other knowledge-management resources.
  • Own and continuously improve onboarding documentation, processes, and team resources.
  • Maintain team documentation repositories, knowledge bases, and collaboration tools, including OneNote.
  • Coordinate management information and reporting to ensure leadership receives timely and accurate updates.
  • Support resource planning, forecasting, and tracking as needed across projects and programs.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify operational gaps and implement process improvements.
  • Coordinate and, where appropriate, lead meetings, forums, and working sessions in support of program objectives.
  • Support colleagues with program processes, tools, documentation standards, and knowledge-management practices.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in program management, project management, or a closely related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting business operations, program administration, and/or executive stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with SharePoint administration and knowledge management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing recurring business rhythms, governance forums, leadership meetings, or operational cadences.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage dependencies, track action items, and drive accountability.
  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, meeting materials, and executive-facing communications.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and changing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret information and translate it into actionable insights.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of operating independently with minimal oversight.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.

Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4.5/5-star rating from hundreds of users. With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages.
